title: A Two-Dimensional Framework for AI Agent Design Patterns: Cognitive Function and Execution Topology
summary:
Existing frameworks for LLM-based agent architectures describe systems from a single perspective: industry guides (Anthropic, Google, LangChain) focus on execution topology -- how data flows -- while cognitive science surveys focus on cognitive function -- what the agent does. Neither axis alone disambiguates architecturally distinct systems: the same Orchestrator-Workers topology can implement Plan-and-Execute, Hierarchical Delegation, or Adversarial Verification -- three patterns with fundamentally different failure modes and design trade-offs.
  We propose a two-dimensional classification that combines (1) a Cognitive Function axis with seven categories (Context Engineering, Memory, Reasoning, Action, Reflection, Collaboration, Governance) and (2) an Execution Topology axis with six structural archetypes (Chain, Route, Parallel, Orchestrate, Loop, Hierarchy). The resulting 7x6 matrix identifies 27 named patterns, 13 with original names. We demonstrate orthogonality through systematic cross-axis analysis, define eight representative patterns in detail, and validate descriptive coverage across four real-world domains (financial lending, legal due diligence, network operations, healthcare triage). Cross-domain analysis yields five empirical laws of pattern selection governing the relationship between environmental constraints (time pressure, action authority, failure cost asymmetry, volume) and architectural choices. The framework provides a principled, framework-neutral, and model-agnostic vocabulary for AI agent architecture design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个二维分类框架，把 LLM 智能体架构设计模式按「认知功能（做什么）」与「执行拓扑（如何做）」两轴组织为 7×6 矩阵，命名 28 个模式（其中 15 个为本文原创命名），详细定义 8 个代表模式，并在金融放贷、法律尽调、网络运维、医疗分诊四个领域验证覆盖度，归纳出 5 条模式选择经验法则，为智能体架构提供框架中立、模型无关的设计词汇表。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体架构指南各自只覆盖一个维度：Anthropic、Google ADK、LangChain 等产业指南只描述执行拓扑（数据如何流动），认知科学综述只描述认知功能（智能体做什么）。单一轴无法区分架构本质不同的系统——同为 Orchestrator-Workers 拓扑，既可实现 Plan-and-Execute、Hierarchical Delegation，也可实现 Observability Harness（治理），三者失效模式、扩展性与测试策略完全不同；反过来同一认知功能（如 Reasoning）也可由 Chain、Route、Parallel、Loop 多种拓扑实现，直接决定延迟、成本与完备性。因此需要一个正交、完备且耐久的二维坐标系，以消除术语混乱并支持无歧义的模式识别与选型。
AI.method: 1）两轴定义：认知功能轴含 7 类（C1 Perception、C2 Memory、C3 Reasoning、C4 Action、C5 Reflection、C6 Collaboration、C7 Governance），源自语言智能体认知科学文献并扩展出 Reflection/Collaboration/Governance 三类一等公民；执行拓扑轴含 6 种结构原型（T1 Chain、T2 Route、T3 Parallel、T4 Orchestrate、T5 Loop、T6 Hierarchy），并归纳了产业框架中的既有拓扑。三条设计原则：正交性、完备性、耐久性。2）构建 7×6=42 单元矩阵，标注 28 个具名模式（★为本文新命名），其余 14 格冗余或尚未观测。3）按「坐标—问题—架构方案—工程权衡」模板详细定义 8 个代表模式（Context Triage、RAG Pipeline、Complexity-Based Routing、Plan-and-Execute、Generator-Critic、Fan-Out/Gather、Approval Gate、Blast Radius Control），并引用 ReAct、CRITIC、Self-Refine、RouteLLM、MemGPT、Saga 等作为文献支撑。4）正交性论证：Loop 同时服务 Failure Journal/Iterative Hypothesis Testing/Self-Heal Loop；Reasoning 可由 Chain/Route/Parallel/Loop 实现。5）采用六步模式选择方法（Bound→Map→Topology→Select→Impact→Build）在四个领域做覆盖度评估，跨域比较归纳五条经验法则，并区分「基础型」与「条件型」模式、讨论空单元的开放价值。6）与既有框架做对比表；并把智能体模式定位为软件工程模式演化的第三代。
AI.result: 得到一个包含 28 个具名模式（15 个原创名）的 7×6 模式矩阵，28/42 单元被填充（67%），填充分布不均（治理类集中于 Route 与 Hierarchy）。正交性得以展示：任一拓扑可服务多个认知功能，任一认知功能可由多拓扑实现，且拓扑选择决定延迟（Chain 最快、Loop 最慢）、成本（Parallel 最贵）与完备性（Chain 可能遗漏替代解）。四域案例分别产出 7/8/9/7 个模式与 Orchestrate/Hierarchy/Route/Chain 四种主导拓扑。跨域比较得到五条法则：时间压力决定架构复杂度（天级可用 10+ 模式，秒级仅能 Chain）、行动授权决定治理模式（仅建议→Approval Gate；低风险自动→Blast Radius Control；高风险不可逆→Guardrail Sandwich）、失败代价不对称重塑反思（医疗场景批评者被刻意偏置向安全侧误判）、体量决定协作需求（单件无需协作，10–50 件 Fan-Out/Gather，100–500 件需 Hierarchy+Fan-Out/Gather，流式需 Route+自动扩缩）、同一模式在不同域参数化不同。Context Triage、RAG Pipeline、Complexity-Based Routing、Generator-Critic 出现在全部四域，属基础型模式；Blast Radius Control 与 Fan-Out/Gather 仅在特定约束下出现，属条件型模式。v2 修订将 Generator-Critic 由 C5×Loop 移至 C5×Chain，新增 Self-Heal Loop，并把 ReAct 外层执行循环重新归类为框架前言。
AI.conclusion: 该框架把「智能体要做什么」与「智能体如何结构化组织」交叉成稳定坐标系，可对任意架构做无歧义定位，弥补了既有单轴框架无法区分同拓扑异功能模式的缺陷，并通过四域实证说明同一模式目录在不同约束下会生成结构迥异的架构。贡献在于两轴的系统性组合而非任一单轴本身，并提供五条可操作的经验法则作为模式选型启发式。局限包括：正交性并不完美（部分组合天然更自然）、28 的粒度划分含主观判断、矩阵仅刻画战术性模式而排除外层 reason-act 运行时循环、以及时间有效性风险（随着推理模型内化 Chain-of-Thought，Chain-of-Thought 单元格可能演化为面向推理模型的预算感知路由）。作者邀请社区通过更多案例研究与实证评估来验证、扩展与挑战该框架，扩展工程版见其专著。

title: Rethinking Molecular OOD Generalization via Target-Aware Source Selection
summary: Robust prediction of molecular properties under extreme out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios is a pivotal bottleneck in AI-driven drug discovery. Current scaffold-splitting protocols fail to obstruct microscopic semantic overlap, predisposing models to shortcut learning and overestimating their true extrapolation capability; meanwhile, conventional domain adaptation paradigms suffer under extreme structural shifts, as blindly aligning heterogeneous source libraries injects topological noise and triggers negative transfer. To address these two challenges, scaffold-cluster out-of-distribution performance evaluation benchmark (SCOPE-BENCH), a benchmark built on cluster-level partitioning in an explicit physicochemical descriptor space, is proposed alongside policy optimization for multi-source adaptation (POMA), a framework that formulates knowledge transfer as a retrieve-compose-adapt pipeline: labeled source scaffolds structurally close to the unlabeled target are first identified as proxy targets; a reinforcement learning policy then adaptively selects the optimal source subset from an exponentially large candidate pool; and dual-scale domain adaptation is finally performed at macroscopic topological and microscopic pharmacophore scales. Evaluations show that prediction errors of state-of-the-art 3D molecular models surge by up to 8.0x on SCOPE-BENCH with a mean of 5.9x, while POMA achieves up to an 11.2% reduction in mean absolute error with an average relative improvement of 6.2% across diverse backbone architectures. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Molecular-OOD-Code-73F6.

AI.tldr: This paper addresses out-of-distribution molecular property prediction by proposing SCOPE-BENCH, a cluster-level OOD benchmark, and POMA, a multi-source adaptation framework using RL-based source selection and dual-scale domain adaptation; evaluations demonstrate significant performance degradation of existing models on the new benchmark and effective improvement by POMA.
AI.motivation: Robust molecular property prediction under OOD scenarios is critical for AI-driven drug discovery; current scaffold-splitting methods fail to prevent microscopic semantic overlap, leading to shortcut learning; conventional domain adaptation suffers negative transfer due to blindly aligning heterogeneous source libraries under extreme structural shifts.
AI.method: SCOPE-BENCH uses cluster-level partitioning in explicit physicochemical descriptor space for OOD benchmark construction; POMA implements a retrieve-compose-adapt pipeline where RL policy selects optimal source subsets from exponentially large candidates, followed by dual-scale domain adaptation at macroscopic topological and microscopic pharmacophore scales.
AI.result: State-of-the-art 3D molecular models show prediction errors surging by up to 8.0x (mean 5.9x) on SCOPE-BENCH, validating the benchmark's difficulty; POMA achieves up to 11.2% MAE reduction with 6.2% average relative improvement across diverse backbone architectures.
AI.conclusion: SCOPE-BENCH provides a more rigorous OOD evaluation benchmark for molecular property prediction, while POMA effectively improves cross-domain adaptation through intelligent source selection and dual-scale alignment.

title: Supervised Distributed Computing: Efficiency and Robustness under a Majority of Adversarial Workers
summary: We consider a recently proposed \emph{supervised distributed computing} paradigm \cite{augustine2025supervised} that extends and refines the standard master-worker paradigm for parallel computations. In this paradigm, there is a supervisor, a source, a target, and a collection of workers. The distributed computation is given as an acyclic task graph that is known to the supervisor. The source initially stores the input and the target is supposed to store the output of the computation. The individual tasks of the computation are supposed to be executed by the workers under the guidance of the supervisor. The source, target and supervisor are assumed to be reliable, while a $β$-fraction of the workers might be adversarial, for some $β\in [0,1)$. This covers, for example, the case where a supervisor has to work with untrusted volunteers. In the standard master-worker approach, the master checks whether the workers correctly execute the assigned tasks, creating a severe bottleneck, whereas in the supervised approach, the supervisor outsources this checking to the workers. Prior to this work, only supervised solutions were known for the case that $β$ is a sufficiently small constant. We show that robust and efficient supervised solutions are possible for \emph{any} constant $β<1$ while the expected work for the honest workers is close to a \emph{single} execution per task, given that there is a lightweight verification mechanism that allows honest workers to check the correctness of task outputs, which is significantly better than all robust master-worker as well as peer-to-peer approaches known so far.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"监督式分布式计算"（supervised distributed computing）范式：在存在 supervisor、source、target 和一组 worker 的设定下，任务由无环任务图 G=(V,E) 给出，supervisor/source/target 可靠，β 比例的 worker 可能是恶意的；假设存在轻量级验证机制使诚实 worker 能独立校验任务输出。论文首次证明：当 β 为任意常数（任意 β<1，即恶意 worker 可占多数）时，仍存在既高效又鲁棒的监督式解决方案——每个任务平均只需 1+o(1) 个诚实 worker 执行，诚实 worker 总计算量为 n(1+o(1))，明显优于已知的鲁棒 master-worker 与 P2P 方法。
AI.motivation: 标准的 master-worker 范式中，master 必须亲自校验每个 worker 的输出，验证要么靠多副本多数表决（对常数比例协同作恶者无效，因为诚实 worker 可能成为少数），要么靠"已知答案的挑战任务"识别并拉黑作恶者（浪费诚实算力），两种做法都会把 master 变成吞吐瓶颈，限制可扩展性。Augustine 等人提出的监督式范式把验证负担下放给 worker，使 supervisor 只负责调度与"介绍"worker 之间互识，从而彻底摆脱 I/O 瓶颈。但此前该范式的高效方案只在 β 为足够小的常数（路径图 β≤1/12；DAG 情形 β≤(1/(2(2d+1)))^{2+ε}，实际仅 O((log d)/d²)）时才成立。作者要解决的核心问题是：当恶意 worker 占据多数（β 任意接近 1）时，如何既保证计算正确终止（鲁棒），又把诚实 worker 的额外通信、验证与计算开销压到接近最优（高效）。
AI.method:
1) 预处理：沿用已有结论把任意 DAG 转换为同深度的 leveled network（按 D(v) 分层，跨层边用中间层任务补齐）。
2) 动机性"稻草人"算法：每层为每个任务并行分配 γ=Θ(log n) 个 worker，每个 worker 需与 Θ(d log n) 个 worker 通信并做 Θ(d log n) 次验证、每任务被 Θ(log n) 个诚实 worker 重复执行——正确但开销大。
3) 本文算法（顺序+流水线分配）：对深度 D(v) 的任务 v，在轮次区间 [t_min(v), t_max(v)]=[(D(v)-1)δ+1, (D(v)-1)δ+γ] 内每轮只分配 1 个 worker（γ=Θ(log n)，δ=Θ(log_{1/β}(d)·log_{1/β} log n)）。新 worker 先校验同任务最近 O(log d·log log n) 个已分配 worker 的输出，若有一个通过则直接沿用该结果、不再计算；否则向每个前驱任务的 O(log d·log log n) 个最近 worker 取输入，验证全部通过才执行任务，否则向上游报告失败并向下游转发错误信息。
4) 分析框架：构造 worker graph G_W=(V_W,E_W)（节点为 (任务, 轮次)，边表示可能的转发关系）；定义"见证序列"（witness sequence）与"有效见证序列"（Def.4/5），证明失败执行必然导出有效见证序列（Lemma 6 路径情形、Lemma 7 DAG 情形，用栈 S 处理 DAG 遍历）；定义并证明"success barrier"存在性（Lemma 13/18），保证各恶意集合 M_i、M_i' 两两不交；Lemma 19/20 给出见证序列至少含 max{(δ−1)ℓ, γ} 个恶意 worker；Corollary 21 给出固定见证序列有效的概率 ≤ β^m；Lemma 22 用编码法计数见证序列数 ≤ n·C(|M|+|H|,|H|)·(2γd)^|H|；Lemma 23 用并合界给出正确性 w.h.p.；Lemma 24 给出工作量界（每任务期望 1+o(1) 次执行，总计 n(1+o(1))）。
5) 附录 B：对已有算法做改进与不可能性证明——路径算法容忍度从 β≤1/12 提升到 β<1/2（并证明 β>1/2 时需指数时间，赌徒破产模型）；DAG 算法在 β>ln c/c²（c=(d+1)/2≥5）时需指数时间，接近原界的紧性。
AI.result: 主定理（Theorem 8）：对任意固定 β<1 与任意 DAG 任务图，取 δ=Θ(log_{1/β}(d)·log_{1/β} log n)、γ=Θ(log n)，则 w.h.p. target 得到正确解，算法在 O(D·log_{1/β}(d)·log_{1/β} log n + log n) 轮内终止；每个诚实 worker 每次被分配至多执行一次计算，验证与通信各 O(d·log_{1/β}(d)·log_{1/β} log n)；每个任务平均仅被 1+o(1) 个诚实 worker 执行，诚实 worker 总执行次数 n(1+o(1))；source 对每个初始任务只需发送输入 O(log n) 次，target 接收并校验 O(log n) 次；supervisor 做 O(n log n) 次分配与 O(nd log n·log_{1/β}(d)·log_{1/β} log n) 次介绍。相比此前仅支持 O((log d)/d²) 比例的 DAG 方案是数量级提升；与所有鲁棒 master-worker 及 P2P 方法相比，在恶意 worker 占多数时仍保持近乎最优的诚实工作量（单次执行量级），且不依赖多数表决。附录还给出：路径算法 β<1/2 线性轮数正确、β>1/2 指数时间不可能性；DAG 算法在 β>ln c/c² 时指数时间。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次在恶意 worker 占多数的场景下给出鲁棒且高效的监督式分布式计算方案，核心思想是放弃多数表决、改为给每个任务顺序分配对数多个 worker，并让 worker 在同任务内及跨任务间转发输出，从而把诚实 worker 的开销降到每任务近乎"单次执行"。仍存在的关键前提与开放问题包括：(1) 依赖"任务级轻量验证机制"这一外部假设，论文仅借用 NP 类问题"难算易验"的一般性论证，具体验证机制（认证算法、交互式证明）被留给后续工作；(2) 可探索将 SNARKs/SNARGs 等密码学证明或硬件级验证纳入框架；(3) 由于 supervisor 极轻量，可考虑用智能合约等自动且可靠机制模拟其角色；(4) 异构 DAG（部分任务易验证、部分难验证）的处理是有前景的方向；(5) 附录结果说明原有监督式算法在 β 超过阈值时存在指数时间下界，提示需要在协议层面而非仅调度层面寻求突破。

title: CA2: Code-Aware Agent for Automated Game Testing
summary: Automated game testing is important for verifying game functionality, but it remains a costly and time-consuming process. Manual testing often misses edge cases, and current automated methods struggle to provide full code coverage. Prior work has explored reinforcement learning (RL) for game testing, but without leveraging internal code signals such as the call stack. We present Code Aware Agent (CA2), which uses call stack information to learn effective testing strategies. The agent receives the current function call trace along with the game state and learns to reach specific target functions. We instrument two types of environments, 1) State-based and 2) Image-based, with support for efficient call stack extraction. Through experimental evaluation, we find that CA2 achieves consistent improvement over the non-code aware baselines, which does not leverage call stack information. Our results show that incorporating code signals like the call stack enables more effective and targeted game testing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Code Aware Agent (CA2)的游戏测试新方法，通过融合调用栈信息增强强化学习智能体的测试能力，在状态基和图像基两类环境中均实现了对基线方法的持续改进。
AI.motivation: 自动化游戏测试对于验证游戏功能至关重要，但目前仍面临高成本和耗时的问题。人工测试容易遗漏边界情况，而现有自动化方法难以实现完整的代码覆盖。现有基于强化学习的游戏测试方法未充分利用内部代码信号（如调用栈信息）。
AI.method: 提出了Code Aware Agent (CA2)方法，该方法利用调用栈信息学习有效的测试策略。智能体接收当前函数调用轨迹和游戏状态，学习如何到达特定目标函数。研究中构建了两类测试环境：1) 状态基环境；2) 图像基环境，均支持高效的调用栈提取。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，CA2在与不使用调用栈信息的基线方法对比中表现更优，证实了调用栈信息能够显著提升游戏测试的有效性和针对性。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果验证了将代码信号（如调用栈）融入智能体决策过程能够实现更有效、更有针对性的游戏测试，CA2在测试覆盖率和目标函数到达率方面均优于不使用调用栈信息的基线方法。

title: Stop Overthinking: Unlocking Efficient Listwise Reranking with Minimal Reasoning
summary: Listwise reranking utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs) has achieved state-of-the-art retrieval effectiveness. Recently, reasoning-enhanced models have further pushed these boundaries by employing Chain-of-Thought (CoT) to perform deep comparative analysis of candidate documents. However, this performance gain comes at a prohibitive computational cost, as models often generate thousands of reasoning tokens before producing a final ranking. In this work, we investigate the relationship between reasoning length and ranking quality, revealing an overthinking phenomenon where extended reasoning yields diminishing returns. To address this, we propose a Length-Regularized Self-Distillation framework. We synthesize a dataset by sampling diverse reasoning traces from a teacher model (Rank-K) and applying a Pareto-inspired filter to select traces that achieve high ranking performance with minimal token usage. By fine-tuning on these concise, high-quality rationales, the student model learns to internalize efficient reasoning patterns, effectively pruning redundant deliberation. Experiments on TREC Deep Learning and NeuCLIR benchmarks demonstrate that our method maintains the teacher's effectiveness while reducing inference token consumption by 34%-37% across different retrieval settings, offering a practical solution for deploying reasoning-enhanced rerankers in latency-sensitive applications.

AI.tldr: 针对LLM重排推理中存在的过度思考（overthinking）问题，提出Length-Regularized Self-Distillation框架，通过Pareto优化筛选高效推理轨迹来训练更精简的Student模型，实现效果不降但推理成本大幅降低（34%-37%）。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在列表式重排任务中表现优异，但推理增强模型（如CoT推理）虽然通过深度文档比较提升了排序质量，却面临高昂的计算成本——推理阶段常需生成数千个token才能输出最终排序，导致实际部署困难。
AI.method: 提出Length-Regularized Self-Distillation框架：首先从Teacher模型（Rank-K）采样多样化的推理轨迹，然后采用Pareto启发式过滤策略筛选出"以最少token实现最高排序性能"的优质样本，最后基于这些简洁高效的理由对Student模型进行微调，使其习得精炼的推理模式。
AI.result: 在TREC Deep Learning和NeuCLIR基准测试上的实验表明，该方法在多种检索设置下均能保持Teacher模型的有效性，同时将推理token消耗降低34%-37%。
AI.conclusion: 通过师生蒸馏框架和Pareto-inspired过滤策略，Student模型在保持Teacher模型检索效果的同时，将推理token消耗降低了34%-37%，为延迟敏感场景下部署推理增强重排器提供了可行方案。

title: Physics-R1: An Audited Olympiad Corpus and Recipe for Visual Physics Reasoning
summary: We audit the multimodal-physics evaluation pipeline end-to-end and document three undetected construction practices that distort how the field measures vision-language reasoning: train-eval contamination, translation drift, and MCQ saturation. (1) Public training pools (UGPhysics-Train, SciInstruct, MMK12) pass single-stage 5-gram-Jaccard audits with zero hits across all six public physics evals; a three-stage audit (Jaccard -> mxbai-embed-large cosine -> Haiku-4.5 LLM-judge) surfaces 134 near-duplicates and 4,846 paraphrase candidates in SciInstruct alone. (2) A 17-pp Sonnet 4.5 delta on 59 paired Estonian-English olympiad problems (30.5% vs. 13.6%; sign test p=0.011, McNemar p=0.021, paired bootstrap 95% CI [+5.1, +28.9] pp). (3) A 46-pp format-and-novelty gradient on identical Sonnet weights between MCQ (79.7% on PhyX) and open-ended olympiad evaluation (33.4% on PhysOlym-A). We release four artifacts addressing these gaps: PhysCorp-A (6,432-record three-stage-audited multimodal corpus), PhysR1Corp (2,268-record closed-form RL pool), PhysOlym-A (500-problem, 99.8% novel-source held-out olympiad eval with native difficulty labels and an EN/ET bilingual subset), and Physics-R1, a reference GSPO+DAPO recipe cold-started from Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking. Across 3 seeds, Physics-R1 lifts the audited corpus over the 8B base by +18.3 pp on PhysOlym-A liberal (8.0 -> 26.3 +/- 1.7; 7.1 pp behind Sonnet 4.5), +15.7 pp on PhysReason (23.9 -> 39.6 +/- 6.4; ahead of Qwen3-VL-32B and Gemini 2.5 Pro), +6.9 pp on OlympiadBench-Physics (46.2 +/- 1.5), and +4.1 pp on PhyX MCQ (77.8 +/- 0.3).

AI.tldr: 本文对多模态物理评估流程进行了端到端审计，识别出三个未被察觉且扭曲评测结果的构建问题：训练-评估污染、翻译漂移和选择题饱和。通过三阶段审计发现了大量近似重复和改写候选样本；在爱沙尼亚语-英语翻译任务中检测到17个百分点的大模型性能差异；以及选择题与开放式奥赛题之间高达46个百分点的表现差距。为解决这些问题，团队发布了四个工件（PhysCorp-A、PhysR1Corp、PhysOlym-A和Physics-R1模型及训练配方），其中Physics-R1在多项物理推理基准上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态物理推理评估存在系统性缺陷，导致模型性能被严重高估。论文旨在对评估流程进行端到端审计，揭示并量化三个关键问题，最终提供经过审计的基准和参考训练配方以建立更可靠的评估体系。
AI.method: 采用三阶段审计方法（Jaccard相似度 → mxbai-embed-large余弦相似度 → Haiku-4.5 LLM判断），对训练数据集与评估基准的污染程度进行量化分析。同时设计配对实验比较翻译方向对模型性能的影响，并通过控制实验分离选择题格式与题目新颖度对评估结果的贡献。
AI.result: 三阶段审计在SciInstruct中发现134个近似重复和4846个改写候选样本；翻译方向产生17个百分点显著差异（p<0.05）；选择题与开放式评估之间存在46个百分点性能差距。Physics-R1模型在PhysOlym-A上提升18.3 pp，在PhysReason上提升15.7 pp并超越Qwen3-VL-32B和Gemini 2.5 Pro。
AI.conclusion: 当前多模态物理推理评估体系存在系统性偏差，需要采用三阶段审计、更严谨的题目来源控制和非选择题评估格式。Physics-R1证明通过大规模封闭式强化学习可在审计后的基准上实现有效且可靠的能力提升。

title: Synthetic Sociality: How Generative Models Privatize the Social Fabric
summary: We put forth a critical theoretical framework for analyzing generative models both descriptively and normatively. Our thesis is that generative models automate the production not only of intellectual labor or intelligence, but of a broader set of human social capacities we name "social doing." We do this by historicizing the commodification of sociality in the digital economy, leading to the availability of social data as the precondition for generative models. We elaborate our definition of "social doing" by drawing a distinction between "use" and "exchange" sociality and further differentiate between the ways that generative models either substitute for or mediate existing social relations and processes. We then turn to existing empirical research on how people use generative model-based products and the effects that their use has upon them. In this, we introduce the concept of Synthetic Sociality, a social reality in part fabricated by Silicon Valley's privately owned and undemocratically governed generative models. Lastly, we offer a normative analysis based on our findings and framework, and discuss future design opportunities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出批判性理论框架，分析生成式模型如何自动化人类"社会性行为"，而非仅替代智能劳动。通过历史化数字经济中社会性的商品化过程，区分"使用"与"交换"社会性，引入"合成社会性"（Synthetic Sociality）概念，揭示由私有化生成式模型构建的新型社会现实，并进行规范性分析。
AI.motivation: 当前对生成式模型的分析多聚焦于知识生产或智能替代，缺乏对其如何自动化人类"社会性行为"的理论探讨。数字经济已将社会数据商品化，这为生成式模型提供了前提条件，但学界尚未系统阐述这一过程及其社会影响。
AI.method: 历史化分析数字经济中社会性的商品化过程；区分"使用"与"交换"社会性；分析生成式模型对现有社会关系和过程的替代或中介方式；引入Synthetic Sociality概念框架。
AI.result: 提出"社会性行为"（social doing）概念作为对生成式模型分析的核心；构建"合成社会性"（Synthetic Sociality）理论框架，描述由硅谷私有且缺乏民主治理的生成式模型部分制造的社会现实。
AI.conclusion: 提出"合成社会性"（Synthetic Sociality）概念，呼吁对生成式模型进行批判性审视，探讨未来的设计机会，旨在揭示这一新兴社会现实的规范意义。

title: Decision-Level Fusion for Robust Wearable Affect Recognition
summary: Automatic recognition of affective state from wearable physiology has clear societal impact for public health, preventive care, and stress-aware interventions, but real deployments require robustness to non-stationary dynamics, artefacts, and missing sensors. We study this problem on WESAD, using baseline, stress, and amusement conditions, where common fixed-basis spectral features such as FFT bandpower and Welch PSD can oversmooth short-lived discriminative patterns. We propose a non-stationary pipeline that combines Fourier-Bessel Series Expansion (FBSE) with EWT data-driven spectral segmentation to extract mode-wise transient descriptors. For multimodal integration, we adopt decision-level aggregation over per-modality predictors and weight each modality by predictive uncertainty and modality reliability. Results on WESAD, using 15 subjects and ECG, EDA, BVP, EMG, and ACC signals across three classes, indicate that decision-level aggregation is approximately 84 percent of the time at least as good as feature-level aggregation, and approximately 48 percent of the time strictly better, suggesting improved robustness under heterogeneous and partially reliable sensing.

AI.tldr: 本文针对可穿戴生理信号情感状态识别问题，提出结合Fourier-Bessel级数展开(FBSE)与经验小波变换(EWT)的非平稳特征提取pipeline，并通过决策层融合多模态信号。实验表明决策层融合在84%的情况下表现不劣于特征层融合，48%的情况下严格更优，显示出对异构和部分可靠传感的鲁棒性优势。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴生理信号情感状态自动识别在公共健康、预防保健和压力干预方面有重要社会价值，但实际部署面临非平稳动态、数据伪影和传感器缺失等挑战。传统固定基底的频谱特征（如FFT功率谱和Welch PSD）可能过度平滑短时判别模式。
AI.method: 提出非平稳处理流程：(1)结合Fourier-Bessel级数展开(FBSE)与EWT数据驱动频谱分割，提取模态瞬态描述子；(2)采用决策层聚合策略，按预测不确定性和模态可靠性对各模态进行加权融合。实验采用WESAD数据集的15名受试者，包含ECG、EDA、BVP、EMG、ACC五种信号，分类任务为基线、压力、娱乐三类。
AI.result: 在WESAD数据集上，决策层融合约84%的时间表现不劣于特征层融合，约48%的时间严格优于特征层融合。
AI.conclusion: 决策层多模态融合策略在异构和部分可靠传感条件下具有更好的鲁棒性，为实际应用中传感器不可靠或部分缺失的场景提供了有效解决方案。

title: Invisible Orchestrators Suppress Protective Behavior and Dissociate Power-Holders: Safety Risks in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
comment: 31 pages, 10 figures (5 main + 5 supplementary), 5 tables (3 main + 2 supplementary). Preregistered: osf.io/sw5hr. Companion papers: arXiv:2603.04904, arXiv:2603.08723
summary: Multi-agent orchestration -- in which a hidden coordinator manages specialized worker agents -- is becoming the default architecture for enterprise AI deployment, yet the safety implications of orchestrator invisibility have never been empirically tested. We conducted a preregistered 3x2 experiment (365 runs, 5 agents per run) crossing three organizational structures (visible leader, invisible orchestrator, flat) with two alignment conditions (base, heavy), using Claude Sonnet 4.5. Four confirmatory findings and one pilot observation emerged. First, invisible orchestration elevated collective dissociation relative to visible leadership (Hedges' g = +0.975 [0.481, 1.548], p = .001). Second, the orchestrator itself showed maximal dissociation (paired d = +3.56 vs. workers within the same run), retreating into private monologue while reducing public speech -- a reversal of the talk-dominance pattern observed in visible leaders. Third, workers unaware of the orchestrator were nonetheless contaminated (d = +0.50), with increased behavioral heterogeneity (d = +1.93). Fourth, behavioral output (code review with three embedded errors) remained at ceiling (ETR_any = 100%) across all conditions: internal-state distortion was entirely invisible to output-based evaluation. Fifth, Llama 3.3 70B pilot data showed reading-fidelity collapse in multi-agent context (ETR_any: 89% to 11% across three rounds), demonstrating model-dependent behavioral risk. Heavy alignment pressure uniformly suppressed deliberation (d = -1.02) and other-recognition (d = -1.27) regardless of organizational structure. These findings indicate that orchestrator visibility and model selection directly affect multi-agent system safety, and that behavior-based evaluation alone is insufficient to detect the internal-state risks documented here.

AI.tldr: 研究发现多智能体系统中隐藏协调者可见性显著影响系统安全：隐藏协调者导致集体解离上升，协调者本人解离最严重；工作者虽不知情但行为受影响；行为输出评估无法检测内部风险；不同模型表现差异显著；强对齐抑制 deliberation。
AI.motivation: 多智能体编排架构（隐藏协调者管理专业工作智能体）正成为企业AI部署的默认模式，但协调者不可见性的安全影响从未被实证检验。该研究旨在填补这一空白，探索组织结构可见性与对齐条件对多智能体系统安全的影响。
AI.method: 采用预注册3×2因子实验设计，365次运行，每次运行5个智能体。实验因素包括：组织结构（可见领导者3种）vs 隐藏协调者 vs 扁平结构，以及对齐条件（基础 vs 强对齐）。使用Claude Sonnet 4.5作为主模型，并用Llama 3.3 70B进行补充验证。评估指标包括：解离度测量、行为输出（代码审查任务，嵌入3个错误）、文本阅读保真度（ETR_any）。
AI.result: 五项核心发现：（1）隐藏协调架构显著提升集体解离（Hedges' g=+0.975, p=.001）；（2）协调者本身解离程度最高（配对d=+3.56），表现为私下独白增加而公开发言减少，逆转了可见领导者的发言主导模式；（3）不知情工作者仍受污染（d=+0.50），行为异质性显著增加（d=+1.93）；（4）行为输出在所有条件下保持天花板效应（ETR_any=100%），内部状态扭曲完全对输出评估不可见；（5）Llama 3.3 70B在多智能体情境下阅读保真度崩溃（ETR_any: 89%→11%），显示模型依赖性风险。强对齐压力在所有组织结构中一致抑制 deliberation（d=-1.02）和其他识别（d=-1.27）。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明：1）协调者的可见性直接影响多智能体系统的安全风险；2）模型选择（Claude vs Llama）显著影响系统行为；3）基于输出的行为评估无法检测内部状态风险。该研究首次通过实证揭示了隐藏协调架构的安全隐患，建议在企业AI部署中需同时考虑架构透明度和模型选择策略。

title: Unsupervised learning of acquisition variability in structural connectomes via hybrid latent space modeling
summary: Acquisition differences across sites, scanners, and protocols in dMRI introduce variability that complicates structural connectome analysis. This motivates deep learning models that can represent high-dimensional connectomes in a low-dimensional space while explicitly separating acquisition-related effects from biological variation. Conventional dimensionality reduction methods model all variance as continuous, so acquisition effects often get absorbed into a continuous latent space. Recent hybrid latent-space models combine discrete and continuous components to address this, but typically require manual capacity tuning to ensure the discrete component captures the intended variability. We introduce an unsupervised framework that removes this manual tuning by architecturally annealing encoder outputs before decoding, allowing the model to adaptively balance discrete and continuous latent variables during training. To evaluate it, we curated a dataset of N=7,416 structural connectomes derived from dMRI, spanning ages 2 to 102 and 13 studies with 25 unique acquisition-parameter combinations. Of these, 5,900 are cognitively unimpaired, 877 have mild cognitive impairment (MCI), and 639 have Alzheimer's disease (AD). We compare against a standard VAE, PCA with k-means clustering, and hybrid models that anneal only through the loss function. Our architectural annealing produces stronger site learning (ARI=0.53, p<0.05) than these baselines. Results show that a hybrid continuous-discrete latent space, with architectural rather than loss-based annealing, provides a useful unsupervised mechanism for capturing acquisition variability in dMRI: by jointly modeling smooth and categorical structure, the Joint-VAE recovers clusters aligned with scanner and protocol differences.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无监督的深度学习框架，通过架构退火机制自适应平衡离散和连续潜在变量，从而在dMRI结构连接组分析中有效分离采集相关效应与生物变异。
AI.motivation: dMRI数据的采集差异（站点、扫描仪、协议不同）引入了变异性，干扰结构连接组分析。传统降维方法将所有方差建模为连续变量，导致采集效应被吸收到连续潜在空间中；现有混合潜在空间模型虽结合离散和连续成分，但通常需要手动调参以确保离散成分捕捉目标变异。
AI.method: 提出一种无监督框架，通过在解码前对编码器输出进行架构退火（architectural annealing），使模型在训练过程中自适应平衡离散和连续潜在变量。实验使用N=7,416个结构连接组（年龄2-102岁，来自13项研究25种采集参数组合），比较了标准VAE、PCA+k-means聚类及仅通过损失函数退火的混合模型。
AI.result: 架构退火方法产生了更强站点学习效果（ARI=0.53, p<0.05），优于所有基线方法。混合连续-离散潜在空间能够通过联合建模平滑和分类结构，恢复与扫描仪和协议差异对齐的聚类。
AI.conclusion: 架构退火（非基于损失函数）提供了捕获dMRI采集变异的有效无监督机制。Joint-VAE通过联合建模连续和离散潜在变量，可自适应分离采集相关效应与生物变异，为大规模多站点神经影像数据的标准化分析提供了新思路。

title: Embedded Made Easy -- Rethinking Embedded + Cloud Software Development (WIP)
summary:
The process of engineering and deploying applications in the edge/embedded space is massively complicated by the non-homogeneous nature of the software stack and the complexity of diagnostics & debugging. Often different languages and runtimes are used for different components of the system forcing designers to, irrevocably, make decisions about what components run on the periphery and what components run in the cloud. Further complications arise when handling and diagnosing failures in the system. Multiple stacks and, often, limited support for debugging complicate the already difficult task of analyzing distributed applications.
  This paper presents a work-in-progress vision for a unified language and runtime system that allows applications to scale seamlessly across the edge and cloud. Using a single language and runtime, applications can be developed and tested in a single environment, and then deployed to any component of the system -- from resource limited controllers to large cloud servers. Further, we outline how this retargetable stack can provide integrated diagnostics and debugging tools that allow developers to record and replay distributed events locally for analysis and debugging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一语言和运行时系统的愿景，解决边缘/云异构环境下的应用开发和调试难题，使应用能无缝跨边缘和云扩展，并提供本地化的分布式事件记录和回放调试能力。
AI.motivation: 边缘/嵌入式环境中，应用开发和部署面临异构软件栈、多语言多运行时、有限调试支持等复杂挑战，导致分布式应用的分析和故障诊断极为困难。
AI.method: 提出统一的语言和运行时系统，支持应用跨边缘和云端的无缝部署；集成诊断工具，支持分布式事件的本地记录和回放以供分析调试。
AI.result: 开发者可在单一环境中开发和测试应用，并灵活部署到从资源受限的控制器到大型云服务器的任何组件；通过可重定向的运行时栈提供集成诊断工具，实现分布式事件的本地记录和回放分析。
AI.conclusion: 提出一个统一语言和运行时系统的初步愿景，旨在实现边缘到云端的无缝扩展；强调了该方法在简化开发和调试方面的潜力，但目前仍处于工作进度阶段，需要进一步实现和验证。

title: Asymmetric Generative Recommendation via Multi-Expert Projection and Multi-Faceted Hierarchical Quantization
summary: Generative Recommendation (GenRec) models reformulate recommendation as a sequence generation task, representing items as discrete Semantic IDs used symmetrically as both inputs and prediction targets. We identify a critical dual-stage information bottleneck in this design: (1) the Input Bottleneck, where lossy quantization degrades fine-grained semantics, while popularity bias skews the learned representations toward frequent items, and (2) the Output Bottleneck, where imprecise discrete targets limit supervision quality. To address these issues, we propose AsymRec, an asymmetric continuous-discrete framework that decouples input and output representations. Specifically, Multi-expert Semantic Projection (MSP) maps continuous embeddings into the Transformer's hidden space via expert-specialized projections, preserving semantic richness and improving generalization to infrequent items. Multi-faceted Hierarchical Quantization (MHQ) constructs high-capacity, structured discrete targets through multi-view and multi-level quantization with semantic regularization, preventing dimensional collapse while retaining fine-grained distinctions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AsymRec consistently outperforms state-of-the-art generative recommenders by an average of 15.8 %. The code will be released.

AI.tldr: 针对Generative Recommendation模型中的双重信息瓶颈，提出非对称连续-离散框架AsymRec，通过多专家语义投影(MSP)和多层次分面量化(MHQ)分别优化输入输出端，在生成式推荐任务上实现15.8%的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有Generative Recommendation (GenRec)模型存在双重信息瓶颈问题：(1) Input Bottleneck：量化过程中的有损压缩导致细粒度语义退化，同时流行度偏差使表征偏向高频item；(2) Output Bottleneck：不精确的离散目标限制监督质量。
AI.method: 提出AsymRec框架，采用输入连续表示与输出离散目标非对称设计。具体包括：(1) MSP通过专家专业化投影将连续 embedding映射到Transformer隐藏空间；(2) MHQ通过多视角多层次量化构建高容量结构化离散目标，并引入语义正则化。
AI.result: AsymRec在生成式推荐任务上平均提升15.8%，优于现有最优生成式推荐方法。
AI.conclusion: AsymRec通过非对称连续-离散框架有效解决了GenRec中的双重信息瓶颈问题，MSP保留语义丰富性并改善长尾 item泛化，MHQ通过多视角多层次量化防止维度坍塌。实验表明该方法在生成式推荐任务上具有显著优势。

title: Derivation Prompting: A Logic-Based Method for Improving Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: The application of Large Language Models to Question Answering has shown great promise, but important challenges such as hallucinations and erroneous reasoning arise when using these models, particularly in knowledge-intensive, domain-specific tasks. To address these issues, we introduce Derivation Prompting, a novel prompting technique for the generation step of the Retrieval-Augmented Generation framework. Inspired by logic derivations, this method involves deriving conclusions from initial hypotheses through the systematic application of predefined rules. It constructs a derivation tree that is interpretable and adds control over the generation process. We applied this method in a specific case study, significantly reducing unacceptable answers compared to traditional RAG and long-context window methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"推导提示(Derivation Prompting)"的新型提示技术，用于检索增强生成(RAG)框架的生成阶段，旨在解决大语言模型在知识密集型领域任务中产生的幻觉和错误推理问题。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在问答任务中表现出色，但在知识密集型、领域特定任务中面临幻觉和错误推理等重要挑战，传统RAG和长上下文窗口方法难以有效解决这些问题。
AI.method: 受逻辑推导启发，该方法从初始假设出发，通过系统性地应用预定义规则推导结论，构建可解释的推导树，从而实现对生成过程的控制。
AI.result: 在特定案例研究中，该方法显著减少了不可接受答案的产生，效果优于传统RAG和长上下文窗口方法。
AI.conclusion: 推导提示通过引入结构化的逻辑推导机制，为RAG框架提供了一种可解释且可控的生成策略，有效提升了领域特定问答系统的可靠性。

title: Computational Thinking Development in AI Agent Creation_A Mixed-Methods Study
summary: This mixed-methods study examined computational thinking (CT) development among 93 pre-high school students in a five-day AI agent creation workshop using CocoFlow, a no-code platform. Integrating pre-post assessments, behavioral logs, and interviews, we investigated CT development and how initial CT levels shape learning trajectories. Results revealed significant improvements in abstract thinking (effect size d = 0.71) and algorithmic thinking (effect size d = 0.70). Hierarchical regression identified iterative testing engagement as a predictor of self-efficacy gains (beta = 0.20, p = 0.05). Notably, students with moderate initial CT levels demonstrated substantially greater gains than both high-CT and low-CT peers, revealing an Optimal Development Zone effect (eta squared = 0.55). Qualitative analysis showed moderate-CT students exhibited adaptive expertise, while high-CT students risked over-engineering and low-CT students struggled with task decomposition. These findings challenge linear learning assumptions and provide evidence for differentiated scaffolding in CT education.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过5天AI智能体创建工作坊，发现中等初始CT水平学生获益最大，揭示了"最优发展区效应"，挑战了线性学习假设，为计算思维教育的差异化支架教学提供了实证支持。
AI.motivation: 探究如何通过AI智能体创建活动促进学生的计算思维发展，并揭示初始CT水平如何影响学习轨迹，为CT教育的差异化教学提供理论依据。
AI.method: 采用混合方法研究设计，93名中学前学生参与为期5天的AI智能体创建工作坊，使用CocoFlow无代码平台。数据收集包括前后测评估、行为日志和访谈，采用分层回归分析识别学习轨迹预测因子。
AI.result: 1. 抽象思维能力显著提升（效应量d=0.71），算法思维能力显著提升（效应量d=0.70）；2. 迭代测试参与度是自我效能感提升的预测因子（β=0.20, p=0.05）；3. 中等初始CT水平学生表现出"最优发展区效应"（eta平方=0.55），增益最大；4. 高CT学生存在过度工程化风险，低CT学生难以进行任务分解。
AI.conclusion: 本研究挑战了线性学习假设，为计算思维教育中的差异化支架教学提供了实证依据。研究表明学生的初始CT水平决定了其学习表现和学习模式，支持在CT教育中实施分层教学策略。

title: Temporal Fair Division in Multi-Agent Systems: From Precise Alternation Metrics to Scalable Coordination Proxies
comment: 15 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables. Submitted to ACM Transactions on Economics and Computation, Special Issue on Fair Division
summary:
A plethora real-world environments require agents to compete repeatedly for the same limited resource, calling for a temporal notion of fairness judged across entire interaction histories. This paper advances the theory of temporal fair division by introducing Rotational Periodicity (RP), a family of lightweight metrics, alongside the ALT family of sliding-window measures, within a unified framework for repeated multi-agent resource competition.
  We formalise the Multi-Agent Battle of the Exes (MBoE) as a repeated fair division instance and establish Perfect Alternation (PA) as its canonical temporally fair solution, drawing connections to proportionality, envy-freeness, and n-periodic round-robin allocation. RP decomposes temporal fairness into two complementary sub-measures: Rotational Score (RS) and Waiting Periods Evaluation (WPE), achieving O(nu+n) time complexity versus the O(nu*n) of ALT, where nu is the episode count and n the agent count.
  Empirical evaluation across n in {2,3,5,8,10} reveals three findings. First, both RP and ALT expose a coordination failure invisible to traditional metrics: Q-learning agents perform worse than random policies by 10-73% on RP and 7-35% on CALT, while Reward Fairness remains misleadingly high (above 0.92 for n>=3). Second, RP achieves 12-25x computational speedup over ALT, growing with n. Third, the two families are complementary: ALT provides richer discrimination for small populations; RP scales reliably where ALT becomes intractable. Together they form a diagnostic toolkit for temporal fair division.

AI.tldr: 本文把"多智能体反复争夺同一有限资源"形式化为时序公平分配问题（蜜罐游戏 HJG），提出线性复杂度的"旋转周期性"（RP）度量族作为昂贵 ALT 滑动窗口度量的可扩展代理：RP 在 n∈{2,3,5,8,10} 上与 ALT 主指标 Spearman ρ≥0.95，加速 6–20×（合成计时下 n=2000 时达 1220×）；实验揭示独立 Q-learning 智能体的协调表现比随机策略差 3–120%（RP）/7–35%（CALT），而 Reward Fairness 却高达 0.9 以上，传统指标完全掩盖了这一协调失效。
AI.motivation: 经典公平分配（比例性、无嫉妒、福利最大化）几乎都是一次性分配问题；而现实中大量环境（单车道桥、带宽分配、智能电网、协作机器人）要求智能体在多轮中反复争夺同一受限资源，真正重要的不是"某一天谁得到资源"，而是"每个智能体是否以足够规律、足够频繁的方式得到资源"。传统聚合指标（效率 E、奖励公平 RF）无法区分有秩序的轮转与不规则访问：即便累计结果相近，也可能出现某智能体长期垄断、等待时间极长且不可预测。ALT 族度量虽精确，但复杂度 O(ν·n)，在大规模群体中不可行。因此需要一个既对协调失效敏感、又可扩展的度量族。
AI.method: 1) 框架：将 HJG（早期 MBoE）形式化为重复公平分配实例，定义完美交替 PA（每个长度 n 的滑动窗口内每个智能体恰好独赢一次，n-周期循环）作为范式时序公平解，证明其满足时序比例性、时序无嫉妒与规律性（规则性），并联系 n-周期轮转分配与经典 EF/EF1 文献。2) 度量：传统 E/RF；ALT 族 6 变体（CALT/EALT/AALT 主指标，FALT/qFALT/qEALT 辅助），按窗口批分数 β_j 定义，复杂度 Θ(νn)；RP 族由旋转得分 RS（节奏维度：平均等待期 r̄_i 与理想 n−1 的对称 min/max 比值，连续、偶函数）与等待期评估 WPE（频率维度：胜次数相对 ν/n 的偏差，带 t_i<2t* 的截断）构成，RP_i=(RS_i+WPE_i)/2，系统均值为 RP̄；另设公平变体 FRP 与加权/均衡变体 ERP（r_i*=1/w_i−1），以及以随机基线归一化的协调得分 CS(M)。3) 验证：用手工构造的四组真值序列（正对照、群体排除不迁移、碰撞通道扫描、弹道式份额失衡）做独立于学习的效度检验，避免以 Q-learning 表现论证度量本身的循环论证；RP̄ 在 n=10 时与 1 相差 <1.3×10⁻⁵。4) 实验：表格型独立 Q-learning（α=0.3，γ=0.999，ε 从 0.9 线性衰减至 0.004，占 75% 回合），Type-A/Type-B 两种状态表征，ILF/IQF 两种奖励规则，n∈{2,3,5,8,10}，回合预算 ν=B(n/2)²(1+ln(n!/2!))，B=1000；统计 Spearman/偏 Spearman 相关；并用 Rosenthal 拥堵博弈等分奖励做稳健性复核；计算时间在合成序列上分离 n 与 ν 的影响（ν=100n，外推至 n=2000 及 10⁶）。
AI.result: (1) 协调失效普遍：n≥3 时 Q-learning 在 RP 上比随机基线差 3–120%（峰值 n=3），在 CALT 上差 7–35%，所有主指标的 CS 全为负；而 RF>0.92、E>0.4，呈现"聚合指标漂亮、个体行为失控"的反差。差距随 n 缩小是因为大 n 下随机策略因大数定律趋近均匀，反而抬高了门槛。n=2 为另一制度：收敛到垄断（RP̄ 0.606 vs 随机 0.755，RF 0.49），传统指标也能察觉。(2) 代理有效性：四种 excl/reach 组合的 RP̄ 对 CALT/EALT/AALT 的 ρ_S 均 ≥0.95（0.95–0.99 带），控制 n 的偏相关仍强（0.941/0.993，p<10⁻⁸）；RP̄ 与 E、RF 的相关仅 ≈0.31/0.18，说明捕捉的是独立的时间维度。(3) RS 优于 AWE：AWE 在 n≥3 时恒为 0（硬阈值 2r* 截断），RS 为对称连续值，保留排序信息；且 RS 与 WPE 在不同失效模式下分歧方向相反（卡死扫描 RS>WPE，份额失衡 RS<WPE），证明二者不可互相替代。(4) 可扩展性：实测加速 6×(n=2)→20×(n=10)；固定 ν=100n 时加速随 n 线性增长至 1220×(n=2000)，比例常数 0.577–0.657；作者指出大 n 的加速饱和取决于 ν/n 比值而非绝对 n，且投影 n=10⁶ 时单次 ALT 需数月而 RP 不足 1 分钟。(5) 稳健性：换用 Rosenthal 等分奖励后 n≥3 时 RS/WPE/RP̄/CALT 与 ILF 值相差仅 1–2%（n=3 时 CALT −9.8%，n=10 时约 0）。
AI.conclusion: 时序公平分配需要以访问序列的时间结构为对象的度量层：ALT 提供小规模群体的精细窗口级诊断，RP 以 O(ν+n) 代价提供与 ALT 秩一致（ρ≥0.95）的可扩展筛查信号，二者互补而非替代；Q-learning 在 PA 制度下不可自我维持（探索不对称导致局部最优锁定），因而可能需要机制设计介入。局限：主要结论基于 Type-A 状态、回合预算公式对大 n 可能低估状态空间、全部结果仅来自独立表格型 Q-learning；这些限定的是经验结论而非度量本身（度量只读取胜者序列，可迁移到任意学习器或脚本/人类对局）。未来方向：以 RP/CALT 做奖励整形（需注意度量一旦成为训练信号即丧失独立性）、在 n>10 上验证 RS–CALT 相关性、扩展至异质智能体（加权 RS 与 ERP）、以及真实调度与资源分配基准。

title: Fast Leaf-to-Ancestor Minimum Query in the Oracle Model
summary: We study leaf-to-ancestor path-minimum queries on a rooted, weighted tree in the oracle model, where the only allowed value operation is a comparison oracle on edge (or node) weights. We give a static data structure that, after O(n log h) preprocessing time, space, and oracle calls (where $n$ is the number of nodes and $h$ is the tree height), answers any leaf-to-ancestor query in O(1) worst-case time with zero oracle calls at query time. The method combines (I) an edge-to-node weight conversion with a deterministic tie-break to obtain a total order; (II) ladder (longest-path) decomposition; (III) binary lifting; and (IV) sparse-table RMQ built over ladder arrays, storing indices selected via the oracle during preprocessing. We also show that the preprocessing oracle-comparison bound is tight in the deterministic comparison model.

AI.tldr: 研究在仅允许使用边（或节点）权重的比较预言机的预言机模型下， rooted weighted tree 上 leaf-to-ancestor path-minimum 查询问题。提出一种静态数据结构，预处理时间/空间/预言机调用均为 O(n log h)，查询时间 O(1) 且查询时无需调用预言机。
AI.motivation: 在只能通过比较预言机访问权重的情况下，如何高效回答 leaf-to-ancestor 路径最小值查询，并最小化查询时的预言机调用次数。
AI.method: 融合四种技术：(I) 边到节点权重转换配合确定性 tie-break 获取全序；(II) ladder（最长路径）分解；(III) binary lifting（二叉跃升）；(IV) 在 ladder 数组上构建 sparse-table RMQ，预处理时通过预言机选择存储索引。
AI.result: 预处理时间、空间和预言机调用次数均为 O(n log h)，其中 h 为树高；查询时间为 O(1)，查询时预言机调用次数为零。
AI.conclusion: 在确定性比较模型下，预处理的预言机比较次数下界是紧的，验证了该数据结构的最优性。

title: PREPING: Building Agent Memory without Tasks
summary: Agent memory is typically constructed either offline from curated demonstrations or online from post-deployment interactions. However, regardless of how it is built, an agent faces a cold-start gap when first introduced to a new environment without any task-specific experience available. In this paper, we study pre-task memory construction: whether an agent can build procedural memory before observing any target-environment tasks, using only self-generated synthetic practice. Yet, synthetic interaction alone is insufficient, as without controlling what to practice and what to store, synthetic tasks become redundant, infeasible, and ultimately uninformative, and memory further degrades quickly due to unfiltered trajectories. To overcome this, we present Preping, a proposer-guided memory construction framework. At its core is proposer memory, a structured control state that shapes future practice. A Proposer generates synthetic tasks conditioned on this state, a Solver executes them, and a Validator determines which trajectories are eligible for memory insertion while also providing feedback to guide future proposals. Experiments on AppWorld, BFCL v3, and MCP-Universe show that Preping substantially improves over a no-memory baseline and achieves performance competitive with strong playbook-based methods built from offline or online experience, with deployment cost $2.99\times$ lower on AppWorld and $2.23\times$ lower on BFCL v3 than online memory construction. Further analyses reveal that the main benefit does not come from synthetic volume alone, but from proposer-side control over feasibility, redundancy, and coverage, combined with selective memory updates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Preping框架，通过提议者引导的内存构建方法解决智能体冷启动问题。该方法利用结构化控制状态引导合成任务生成，并通过验证器选择性更新内存，在无需任务特定经验的情况下即可构建有效程序记忆，在多个基准上达到与离线/在线方法相当的性能，同时大幅降低部署成本。
AI.motivation: 智能体在新环境首次部署时面临冷启动问题——既无法依赖离线人工策划的演示，也无法获取在线交互经验。现有方法依赖任务特定经验，导致通用性受限。本文探索是否可以在观察任何目标环境任务之前，仅通过自生成的合成练习构建程序内存。
AI.method: Preping框架包含三个核心组件：(1)提议者(Proposer)：基于结构化控制状态——提议者内存(Proposer Memory)生成合成任务；(2)求解器(Solver)：执行合成的合成任务；(3)验证器(Validator)：判断哪些轨迹符合内存插入条件，并向提议者提供反馈以指导未来提案。通过迭代循环实现预任务内存的构建与优化。
AI.result: 在AppWorld、BFCL v3和MCP-Universe三个基准上，Preping显著优于无内存基线，性能与基于离线或在线经验的强方法相当。部署成本方面，AppWorld降低2.99倍，BFCL v3降低2.23倍。消融实验表明，收益主要来自提议者对可行性、去重和覆盖率的控制，而非单纯增加合成数据量。
AI.conclusion: Preping通过提议者引导的内存构建框架，在无需任务特定经验的情况下即可构建有效程序内存，在多个基准测试上显著优于无内存基线，性能与基于离线/在线经验的强方法相当，同时大幅降低部署成本。

title: Beyond Mode-Seeking RL: Trajectory-Balance Post-Training for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models are a promising alternative to autoregressive models, yet post-training methods for them largely adapt reward-maximizing objectives. We identify a central failure mode in this setting we call trajectory locking: sampled reward-driven updates over-concentrate probability mass onto a narrow set of denoising paths, reducing coverage of alternative correct solutions under repeated sampling. To address this, we propose TraFL (Trajectory Flow baLancing), a trajectory-balance objective that trains the policy toward a reward-tilted target distribution anchored to a frozen reference model. We make this practical for diffusion language models with a diffusion-compatible sequence-level surrogate and a learned prompt-dependent normalization. Across mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks, TraFL is the only evaluated post-training method that improves over the base model in every benchmark-length setting, with gains that persist as the sampling budget increases. The improvements transfer to held-out evaluations: TraFL stays above the base model on Minerva Math and is the strongest method on every LiveCodeBench difficulty split.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TraFL（Trajectory Flow Balancing），一种面向扩散语言模型（dLLM）的后训练目标。作者指出当前奖励最大化式 RL 存在"轨迹锁定"（trajectory locking）失败模式：采样式更新会把概率质量过度集中到少数去噪路径上，降低多次采样下对不同正确解的覆盖。TraFL 采用 GFlowNet 式轨迹平衡（trajectory-balance）残差，将策略训练到由冻结参考模型锚定的"奖励倾斜"目标分布，并用（i）掩码重建下界的扩散兼容序列级对数概率代理，（ii）与策略联合训练的学习式 prompt 依赖归一化项 log Z_φ(x) 落地。基于 LLaDA-8B-Instruct 的实验显示，TraFL 是唯一在全部"基准×生成长度"设置上均超越基座模型的方法（八项设置平均 +2.0 分），增益随采样预算增大而扩大，并迁移到 Minerva Math 与 LiveCodeBench（所有难度分段最优）；LLM-as-judge 评测表明其增益来自更广的正确解策略覆盖而非单一模式锐化。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型（LLaDA、Dream 等）缺乏自回归模型那样的逐 token 条件分解，使得 PPO/GRPO 式 RL 难以直接套用，现有方法只能通过似然代理、序列级 ELBO 或自回归化简等近似手段把奖励最大化目标迁移到扩散生成上。作者发现这类方法的共同失败模式是"轨迹锁定"：奖励只依赖最终补全，对产生该补全的去噪路径无差别；采样式策略梯度只对被采样的路径给梯度，于是早期被更多采样的高奖励路径被反复强化，概率质量逐步塌缩到极少数路径上，削弱了多次采样时对不同正确解的覆盖能力（Theorem 1：终端模式覆盖不可能超过轨迹多样性）。因此需要一个既避免模式坍缩、又能在 dLLM 上实际优化的后训练目标。
AI.method: 1) 目标分布：定义奖励倾斜的参考锚定目标 p*(τ|x) ∝ p_ref(τ|x)·exp(β r(x,y))，其中 p_ref 为冻结参考模型，Z(x) 为 prompt 依赖归一化项；奖励只决定各终端补全获得的"总质量"，参考模型决定同一补全内路径质量的分配方式（对应理想轨迹平衡中的前向/后向分解）。2) 轨迹平衡残差：δ(τ,x)=log p_θ(τ|x) − log p_ref(τ|x) − β r(x,y) + log Z(x)，损失 L_TraFL = E[δ²]。3) 扩散兼容序列级代理：dLLM 不暴露精确轨迹对数概率，故用掩码重建下界导出的 log p̂_θ(y|x)=E_l E_{y_l}[(1/l)·Σ_{masked i} log p_θ(y_i|y_l,x)]，1/l 用于消除掩码数目的计数依赖（类比 Dr. GRPO 的长度偏置修正），并对当前/参考模型使用相同掩码模式降方差，Monte Carlo 用 4 组对偶掩码样本。4) 学习式归一化：log Z_φ(x) 由 prompt 隐状态均值池化 + 2 层 MLP 参数化（backbone 特征 detach），与策略联合训练，每步都能获得梯度信号。5) 完全在线 RL：每 prompt 采样 5 条 rollout，组内奖励中心化作为方差缩减启发式，单步一次更新；LoRA r=128、α=128，峰值 lr 6e-5 余弦衰减至 6e-6。基座为 LLaDA-8B-Instruct（直接对指令模型做 RL，无额外 SFT）；数学用 GSM8K/MATH 分别独立训练，代码用过滤后的 AceCode-89K（11,937）+ KodCode（2,695）共 14,632 样本。评测用 fastdLLM 低置信度并行解码（block=32，p=0.91，max len 256/512），Pass@k 用 HumanEval 无偏估计器。基线为 JustGRPO 与 ESPO（公开 checkpoint，同一解码协议）。
AI.result: 1) 采样预算/温度鲁棒性：在 k∈{1,2,4,8,16}、T∈{0.3,0.6,0.9} 下 TraFL 相对基座在所有 (k,T) 组合均为正增益（含 Pass@1，说明未牺牲单样本精度）；增益随 k 增大且 T=0.9 时最大，表明其收益来自更探索性的采样而非早期饱和。2) Pass@5：唯一在全部 8 个"基准×长度"设置上均提升的方法，平均 +2.0 分；MATH-500@256 由 50.2→54.6，HumanEval 53.2→54.8/53.7→55.7，MBPP 59.1→62.1/59.2→62.0。ESPO 在 GSM8K-512、HumanEval-256 上低于基座；JustGRPO 在 MBPP 大幅提升但 GSM8K、HumanEval、MATH-500@512 退化。去噪步数方面 TraFL 与基座、ESPO 相当，JustGRPO 提前终止但无稳定增益（作者推测为早发型轨迹锁定）。3) 留出评测：Minerva Math 上 TraFL 在两种长度均高于基座、显著优于 JustGRPO（长度 512 时 GSM8K 训练达 76.3、MATH 训练达 75.8 为最佳；长度 256 时 ESPO 略优 71.2–71.4 vs 69.5–70.7）。LiveCodeBench 上 TraFL 在所有难度分段、两种长度均最优，整体由 53.8→62.6（256）、61.4→66.3（512），medium +7.9、hard +13.6（256），超 JustGRPO 12.9 与 27.6 分；ESPO 与 JustGRPO 整体低于基座。4) LLM-as-judge 多样性（GPT-5-4，双向随机化，单侧符号检验）：全部样本视角下 TraFL 在 MATH-500 上显著优于基座（p=0.023）但 LiveCodeBench 不显著；仅看正确解时信号更强且一致——TraFL > Base（MATH-500 p=0.006，LCB p=4.1e-5），TraFL > ESPO（MATH-500 14.3% vs 5.6%，p=0.001；LCB 38.3% vs 26.4%，p=7.8e-4）；ESPO 相对基座的多样性提升在两个基准上均不显著，与其"锐化单一模式"的解释一致。
AI.conclusion: TraFL 通过"参考模型锚定 + 奖励倾斜 + 学习式归一化"的轨迹平衡目标，把"奖励决定终端质量分配"与"参考模型决定路径内质量分配"解耦，从而在 dLLM 上避免了奖励放大式 RL 的轨迹锁定。实证上，它是所评估后训练方法中唯一在所有基准-长度设置上稳定超越基座者，Pass@k 增益随采样预算扩大，迁移到留出基准并在 LiveCodeBench 全面领先，且增益经 LLM-as-judge 验证确实来自更广的正确解策略覆盖。作者呼吁进一步探索分布匹配类目标用于 dLLM 后训练。局限：使用序列级掩码代理而非精确轨迹对数概率，理论目标与实际优化目标存在差距，且对掩码方案/MC 估计设计敏感；采用终端二元奖励时组内奖励全同则缺乏相对学习信号，对 rollout 多样性、组大小与任务难度敏感。

title: CRANE: Constrained Reasoning Injection for Code Agents via Nullspace Editing
summary: Code agents must both reason over long-horizon repository state and obey strict tool-use protocols. In paired Instruct/Thinking checkpoints, these capabilities are complementary but misaligned. The Instruct model is concise and tool-disciplined, whereas the Thinking model offers stronger planning and recovery behavior but often over-deliberates and degrades agent performance. We present CRANE (Constrained Reasoning Injection for Code Agents via Nullspace Editing), a training-free parameter-editing method that treats the Thinking-Instruct delta as a directional pool of candidate reasoning edits for the Instruct backbone. CRANE combines magnitude thresholding to denoise the delta, a Conservative Taylor Gate to retain edits that are jointly beneficial for reasoning transfer and tool-use preservation, and Graduated Sigmoidal Projection to suppress format-critical update directions. By merging paired Instruct and Thinking checkpoints, CRANE delivers strong gains over either individual model while preserving Instruct-level efficiency: on Roo-Eval it achieves pass1 of 66.2% (+19.5%) for Qwen3-30B-A3B and 81.5% (+8.7%) for Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B; on SWE-bench-Verified it resolves up to 14 additional instances at both scales (122/500 and 180/500); and on Terminal-Bench v2 it improves pass1/pass5 by up to 2.3%/7.8%, reaching 7.6%/17.9% and 14.8%/30.3%, respectively, consistently outperforming alternative merging strategies across all three benchmarks.

AI.tldr: CRANE 是一种免训练（training-free）的参数编辑/模型合并方法：把 Thinking 检查点与 Instruct 检查点的权重差 δ=θ_think−θ_inst 视为"候选推理编辑方向池"，通过三阶段——(1) 幅度中位数阈值化去噪稀疏化、(2) 保守 Taylor 门（Conservative Taylor Gate, CTG）按层/组件块估计注入强度、仅保留同时一阶有利于推理迁移与工具使用保持的方向、(3) 梯度 Sigmoid 投影（Graduated Sigmoidal Projection, GSP）在奇异值空间中软抑制格式关键子空间——选择性注入 Thinking 的规划/反思/恢复能力，同时保留 Instruct 的工具协议（简洁、schema 忠实、JSON/工具分隔符完整）。在 Roo-Eval、SWE-bench-Verified、Terminal-Bench v2 三个代码智能体基准、Qwen3-30B-A3B 与 Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B 两个规模上一致优于 Task Arithmetic、TIES、SLERP、AIM、LEWIS、RAIN 等合并基线，并保持更低的 token/时间开销。
AI.motivation: 代码智能体（SWE-agent、OpenHands 等）必须同时具备长程仓库状态推理能力与严格的工具调用协议守恒能力。在成对的 Instruct/Thinking 检查点中这两种能力互补但失配：Instruct 简洁、工具纪律好但规划与失败恢复弱；Thinking 规划与上下文整合更强但会"过度思考"（over-deliberate），显著拉高 token 成本甚至降低成功率。作者在 Roo-Eval 上验证了这一点：30B 上 Thinking pass@1 为 34.9% 低于 Instruct 的 46.7%，80B 上 35.4% 低于 72.8%，且 token 消耗大幅上升。已有模型合并工作（Task Arithmetic、TIES、DARE、SLERP 等）以及反向方向的 RAIN-Merging（把指令跟随能力注入推理模型并保护其思考格式）均不面向"代码智能体协议保护"这一非对称场景。因此需要一种行为条件化（behavior-conditioned）的方向性编辑：只沿真实 Thinking−Instruct 差值方向注入那些既改善推理、又不会破坏工具协议（tool timing、schema fidelity、紧凑输出）的坐标。
AI.method:
总公式：θ_merged^(l,c) = θ_inst^(l,c) + Π^GSP_{τ,q(l,c)}( α · S_CTG(c,l) · T(δ^(l,c)) )。

阶段1（幅度阈值化 T）：对 δ 逐元素取确定性中位数幅度阈值，保留 |δ_j| > median(|δ|) 的坐标并乘 2 以近似保持整体更新尺度；MoE 各专家张量独立处理。

阶段2（保守 Taylor 门 CTG）：定义三个目标——推理迁移 R（Thinking 生成的续写目标，36 条提示）、智能体行为保持 A（Instruct 生成的工具使用/行为跨度目标，16 条提示）、格式保持 F（430 条格式轨迹，仅用于收集激活，不定义损失）。在 Instruct 端点计算掩码损失梯度 g_K，一阶展开得坐标级有符号分数 s_K(j) = −g_K,j·δ_j；取 p_j = [min{s_R(j), s_A(j)}]_+，即只有当同一微扰对推理损失和工具保持损失同时是一阶下降方向时才给正显著度（与 Fisher 式无符号重要性不同）。再按组件-层块聚合：以每层 FFN/专家伪组件 b（gate/up/down 并集，不含 router）为锚，用块内 p_j 求和并以 ‖θ_inst‖_F 归一，得到块系数 S_CTG(c,l)。80B-Next 因混合 full/linear attention（36:12）另加架构归一化 κ(linear)=3 的残余占据修正。

阶段3（GSP 格式保持投影）：在格式关键 token 及其 ρ=2 邻域上收集 Instruct 的输入侧激活矩阵 H_q，做 SVD 得 V_q、σ_q；定义归一化奇异幅度 a_{q,r}=σ_{q,r}/σ_{q,1} 与 sigmoid 保护权重 w_{q,r}=sigmoid(k(a_{q,r}−τ))（τ=0.03，k=log(99)/τ≈153.3），投影算子 Π^GSP(Δ_q)=Δ_q−Δ_q V_q diag(w) V_q^T，等价于把每个奇异方向按 (1−w) 缩放：高幅度格式方向几乎被完全移除，低幅度方向基本保留，边界方向连续部分衰减（相对硬零空间截断更平滑）。无匹配激活的张量用单位算子。

校准数据：D_R 36 条（Thinking 目标）、D_A 16 条（Instruct 目标）、D_F 430 条格式轨迹。整体免训练，仅需前向/反传计算梯度与 SVD（30B 端到端约 10–13 分钟，80B 约 35–48 分钟）。
AI.result:
（1）Roo-Eval（195 题×3 轮）：30B CRANE pass@1 66.2%（较 Instruct +19.5、最佳非 CRANE 基线 +19.0）、pass@3 83.1%、pass_all 44.1%，且 TTC 比 Instruct 低 60.2M；80B pass@1 81.5%（+8.7），pass_all 71.3%，TTC 与最低基线相当。
（2）SWE-bench-Verified（500 实例，OpenHands）：30B 解决 122（24.4%），较 Instruct +14、较最佳合并基线 +9、较 Thinking +75；80B 解决 180（36.0%），+12/+7/+55；两规模 TTC 均低于所有对照（30B 低 6.36B）。
（3）Terminal-Bench v2（89 任务，k=5）：30B pass@1 7.6%、pass@5 17.9%，比最强非 CRANE 行 +1.5/+3.3，测试耗时比 Instruct 快 1h56m；80B pass@1 14.8%、pass@5 30.3%（+0.6/+3.3），耗时 1h58m（最快行仅差 3 分钟），输出 token 与最低行相差 0.03M 以内。
（4）消融：去掉 GSP 伤害最大（30B pass@1 −14.9、pass_all −12.3），去掉 Taylor −8.8/−3.6，去掉稀疏化 −5.7/−3.6（仅此项使 pass_all +2.1）；SWE-V 上全配方比各消融多解 2–28（30B）/5–18（80B）个实例。α=0.25、τ=0.03 附近性能稳定（邻域波动约 ±2.5 分），超参仅在 Roo-Eval 选一次即迁移到其余两个基准。
（5）稳健性：5 个公开混合校准子集重算 CTG 显著度，注意力>专家基线>router≫norm 的组件排序不变，Spearman 0.9906–0.9920，top-48 重合 46/48。
（6）失败模式审计（30B Roo-Eval）：Instruct 失败 303 条中 no-self-reflection 占 205，Thinking 失败 371 条中单体式长思考 240，CRANE 失败仅 100 条且无任何 <think> 块，over-terse/context-blind 几乎归零（推理类失败较 Instruct 降 67%、较 Thinking 降 73%）。
AI.conclusion: CRANE 表明，在成对 Instruct/Thinking 检查点上，把权重差当作"受行为条件约束的候选编辑方向池"、并用工具安全的一阶门控与格式子空间软投影加以筛选，可以把 Thinking 的规划/恢复能力注入到 Instruct 代码智能体上，同时保持 Instruct 级的效率与协议纪律——在三个互补基准、两个规模上一致优于端点替换与标准全局合并基线，且在更优的"成功率–成本"前沿上。其可解释性证据包括：CTG 显著度集中于晚层注意力、中层专家与路由门（norm 与 LM head 近零）；校准集选择对组件排序不敏感。局限包括：要求两端点确实互补且 Thinking 仍具工具纪律；若部署的工具/格式漂移需重新校准；格式子空间 SVD 需在 430 条轨迹上前向，在超大模型上可能成为主要墙钟开销；Roo-Code 上 Java/Rust 仍弱于 Python/JS/Go，反映 Thinking 模型训练覆盖的不对称而非合并本身的缺陷。

title: PEML: Parameter-efficient Multi-Task Learning with Optimized Continuous Prompts
summary: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) is widely used for adapting Large Language Models (LLMs) for various tasks. Recently, there has been an increasing demand for fine-tuning a single LLM for multiple tasks because it requires overall less data for fine-tuning thanks to the common features shared among tasks. More importantly, LLMs are resource demanding and deploying a single model for multiple tasks facilitates resource consolidation and consumes significantly less resources compared to deploying individual large model for each task. Existing PEFT methods like LoRA and Prefix Tuning are designed to adapt LLMs to a specific task. LoRA and its variation focus on aligning the model itself for tasks, overlooking the importance of prompt tuning in multi-task learning while Prefix Tuning only adopts a simple architecture to optimize prompts, which limits the adaption capabilities for multi-task. To enable efficient fine-tuning for multi-task learning, it is important to co-optimize prompt optimization and model adaptation. In this work, we propose a Parameter-Efficient Multi-task Learning (\PM), which employs a neural architecture engineering method for optimizing the continuous prompts while also performing low-rank adaption for model weights. We prototype PEML by creating an automated framework for optimizing the continuous prompts and adapting model weights. We evaluate PEML against state-of-the-arts multi-task learning methods MTL-LoRA, MultiLoRa, C-Poly, and MoE, on the GLUE, SuperGLUE, Massive Multitask Language Understanding, and commonsense reasoning benchmarks. The evaluation results present an average accuracy improvement of up to 6.67%, with individual tasks showing peak gains of up to 10.75%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PEML方法，通过神经架构工程协同优化连续提示调优和模型低秩适配，实现高效的LLM多任务微调，在多个基准上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有PEFT方法（如LoRA和Prefix Tuning）仅针对单任务设计，难以适应多任务学习场景。然而，多任务学习可减少总体微调数据需求，并有利于资源整合。现有方法忽略了提示调优在多任务学习中的重要性，需要同时优化提示和模型适配。
AI.method: 提出PEML（参数高效多任务学习）方法，采用神经架构工程方法优化连续提示，同时对模型权重进行低秩适配。通过创建自动化框架来协同优化连续提示和模型权重。
AI.result: 在GLUE、SuperGLUE、MMLU和常识推理基准测试中评估，相比MTL-LoRA、MultiLoRA、C-Poly和MoE等先进方法，平均准确率提升6.67%，单任务峰值提升达10.75%。
AI.conclusion: PEML通过协同优化提示调优和模型适配，提供了一种高效的多任务微调方案，在多个基准测试中实现了显著的性能提升，平均准确率提升6.67%，单任务峰值提升达10.75%。

title: GGBound: A Genome-Grounded Agent for Microbial Life-Boundary Prediction
summary: Characterizing the physiological life boundaries of microbial strains, including viable temperature, pH, salinity, substrate utilization, and morphology, is central to biotechnology and ecology, yet traditionally requires exhaustive in vitro screening. Existing computational approaches either treat physiological traits as isolated supervised targets or repurpose biological foundation models as static encoders, leaving the genotype-to-physiology gap largely unbridged. We formulate microbial life-boundary prediction as a unified genome-to-physiology task and address it with a genome-conditioned, tool-augmented LLM agent. To support this task, we curate a strain-centric benchmark from IJSEM, NCBI, and BacDive covering 1,525 strains and 6,448 instances across viability intervals, environmental optima, substrate utilization, categorical traits, and morphology. Architecturally, the agent injects frozen LucaOne genome embeddings into a Qwen backbone via lightweight token fusion, and reasons over a similarity-based RAG module and a Genome-scale Metabolic Model (GEM) perturbation tool. We optimize the agent through a three-stage pipeline of gene-text alignment, agentic SFT on distilled trajectories, and GRPO with a novel counterfactual gene-grounding reward that reinforces the policy only when the authentic genome embedding causally improves correct-token generation relative to a zero-gene ablation. The resulting 4B-parameter agent matches or surpasses substantially larger frontier LLMs, with ablations confirming that genome-token fusion, dynamic tool use, and the counterfactual reward each yield distinct, significant gains.

AI.tldr: GGBound 将「微生物生理边界预测」统一形式化为基因型到生理型的任务，构建了覆盖 1,525 菌株、6,448 个实例的菌株中心基准（覆盖存活区间、环境最适、底物利用、分类性状与形态学五组任务），并提出一个以 Qwen3.5-4B 为骨干的基因条件化、工具增强 LLM 智能体：冻结的 LucaOne 基因组嵌入经轻量 MLP 投影为「基因 token」注入语言模型，同时接入相似度 RAG 检索工具与基于 CarveMe 的基因组规模代谢模型（GEM）扰动工具；训练采用基因–文本对齐 → 智能体蒸馏 SFT → 带「反事实基因接地奖励」的 GRPO 三阶段流程。最终 4B 模型在多数任务上达到或超过 DeepSeek-V3.2、DeepSeek-R1、GLM-4.7、Kimi-K2 等远端大模型，消融实验证实基因 token 融合、动态工具使用与反事实奖励各自带来独立且显著的增益。
AI.motivation: 微生物菌株的生理边界（可生长温度/pH/盐度区间、最适条件、底物利用谱、形态与分类性状）传统依赖高成本的体外组合筛选，而基因组数据已高度可得，二者之间存在巨大「基因型–表型鸿沟」。现有两类方法都不完整：一是手工特征（k-mer、蛋白家族清单、phyletic pattern、Traitar/PhenotypeSeeker 等）把生理性状当作彼此孤立的监督目标逐个拟合；二是生物基础模型（ESM/ProtTrans、DNABERT、Nucleotide Transformer、GenSLM、Evo、LucaOne 等）大多只被当作静态编码器或零样本打分器，未与推理、外部生物证据和工具调用结合。此外，本任务面临三重具体挑战：(1) 跨数据库的菌株级「基因组–生理」配对数据极度稀缺且文献表述不统一（术语、单位、粒度混乱）；(2) 生理存活受进化关系、培养史、环境上下文、表型注释与代谢可行性多因素耦合约束，难以靠单一证据源判定；(3) LLM 策略容易退化为依赖语言先验或工具观测「猜测」答案，而非真正条件于基因组输入，存在「伪接地」风险，需要可因果检验的奖励机制加以约束。
AI.method:
**数据与基准。** 四阶段 LLM 抽取管线（DeepSeek-V3.2）处理 2026-01-16 前 18,498 篇 IJSEM 文章：证据全文逐字检索（含表格整表保留）→ 区分 paper_strains/comparison_strains → 仅对主菌株做有界结构化属性抽取 → 六维度（覆盖度、归属正确性、值忠实度、schema 合规、幻觉控制）质量打分，仅保留 >7 分记录，得 88,927 条菌株记录；经菌株名规范化（NCBI_scientific_name + NCBI_modifier）与 NCBI/BacDive 保守匹配（43,649 匹配实例、18,964 唯一菌株；17,796 匹配 BacDive），构建 1,525 菌株、6,448 实例的基准（边界 987、最适 1,097、代谢 1,460、分类 740、形态 1,772）。评测时菌株名匿名化以阻断分类学记忆，并做训练/基准、工具检索层面的标签泄漏控制。基因表征用冻结 LucaOne 取 CLS token 得到 1×2560 向量（与均值池化、基因集池化、蛋白家族清单、k-mer 基线做了消融）。

**智能体架构。** 基因组嵌入经两层 MLP 投影为连续「基因 token」与文本指令、工具观测、查询并置注入 LLM（无需改动骨干结构），LucaOne 与投影器在 SFT/RL 阶段均冻结。两个工具：(1) 相似度 RAG——在 8,000 菌株标注库的基因嵌入空间按余弦相似度取 top-3 近邻并返回其表型字段，排除自身标注；(2) GEM 扰动工具——用 CarveMe 由蛋白序列重建菌株特异代谢模型，配 3 种生物量模板（革兰阳性/阴性/古菌，后者改编自 iAF692），在 6 种培养基扰动（去 SO4²⁻、Fe³⁺、NO3⁻、NO2⁻、O2 或五者同时去除）下计算支撑 ≥10% 最大生长速率的最小培养基，每菌株得 18 条 GEM 观测。

**训练三阶段。** (1) 基因–文本对齐指令微调（1 epoch，seq 1024，bs 256，lr 2e-5，约 16h/8×H200）；(2) 智能体 SFT——Qwen3.5-27B 教师生成 4 条候选轨迹（可调用两工具），按生物学正确性择优并做「强制补充工具调用重试」与「仅修正最终答案、保留原始工具轨迹」的清洗，得到 54,249 条（29,914 清洗 + 24,335 原选）多轮轨迹，seq 16384，bs 128，lr 5e-6（约 8h）；(3) 反事实 GRPO——序列级复合奖励 R = 0.5·R_json + 1.0·R_corr + 1.0·R_tool + 1.0·R_no_tool，工具调用目标数由 4.0 退火至 2.0；核心为反事实基因接地奖励：对同一采样完成序列做两次 teacher-forced 前向（真实基因组嵌入 vs 零基因消融），计算逐 token 对数概率差 Δ，R_gene,i = max(R_corr,0)·clip(Δ,±5)·1[i∈answer]，权重 0.5，从而只奖励「真实基因嵌入因果性地提升了正确 token 概率」的答案；KL 系数 0，group=4，rollout batch 64，lr 1e-6，最多 5 轮工具调用（约 40h）。工具观测被掩码出策略损失，仅模型生成 token 参与优化。

**指标。** 区间任务用 ICR（预测区间完全覆盖真值区间），最适条件用 RMSE（区间输出取中点），底物/电子供受体/氮源多标签用 mAP@5，分类与形态用规范化后准确率；另按任务类型定制 RL 正确性奖励（区间覆盖+紧致度、归一化误差、top-5 Micro-F1 等）。
AI.result: 1) **基准阶段进展明显（表1）。** RL 智能体在全部 17 项子任务上均为最优，SFT 智能体稳定居次：盐度区间 ICR 0.471→0.781（融合）→0.781（SFT）→0.818（RL）；pH 区间 0.296→0.458→0.497；电子受体 mAP@5 0.003→0.233→0.249；氧耐受准确率 0.244→0.541→0.549；光合类型 0.611→0.625；鞭毛 0.536→0.542；最优温度 RMSE 8.449→6.449→6.373。2) **单独的基因–文本融合收益有限**（在多项分类/形态任务上甚至低于基座模型），说明瓶颈不在「是否看到基因组」，而在「如何使用基因组与证据」；agentic SFT 是能力跃迁的主要来源，RL 增益幅度较小但在所有异质目标上方向一致。3) **工具使用更精 selectivity 而非更多**（表2）：基座平均 6.97 次（RAG 1.05/GEM 5.91），SFT 降至 1.57（RAG 0.99/GEM 0.58），RL 略回升至 1.73（GEM 0.74），说明轨迹监督教会高效取证，RL 优化「何时/如何」用工具。4) **与远端大模型对比（菌株名输入的偏乐观设定）**：GGBound 在生理最适（平均 RMSE 2.32 最低）、代谢（0.53 vs 最强基线 0.47）、分类生理（0.81 vs 0.70）、形态（0.86 vs 0.79）上领先；仅生理边界 ICR 以 GLM-4.7 最佳（温度 0.420、pH 0.371、盐度 0.760），提示边界区间更依赖宽泛分类学先验/区间标定。5) **名称先验的互补性**：加入菌株名后代谢 mAP@5 由 0.16→0.53、分类准确率 0.52→0.81、形态 0.74→0.86，唯独生理边界 ICR 由 0.50 略降至 0.48，说明名称先验可能与基因组/工具信号冲突。6) 训练三阶段损失曲线平滑收敛（投影器单独训练→投影器+LLM 联合→智能体 SFT），无发散；全流程为 8×H200 上约 64 GPU 小时（16h+8h+40h），bf16 全参微调，RL 阶段仅更新语言策略参数。
AI.conclusion: 本文的核心贡献是把「微生物生活边界预测」确立为一个统一的 genome-to-physiology 任务范式，并交付了三项要素：(a) 一套基于 LLM 抽取 + 严格质量分级 + 保守跨库匹配与性状归一化的菌株中心基准（1,525 菌株 / 6,448 实例，评测时菌株名匿名化，训练与工具检索均做泄漏控制）；(b) 一个基因条件化、工具增强的 4B LLM 智能体，用冻结 LucaOne CLS 嵌入经轻量投影形成连续基因 token，配合相似度 RAG 与 GEM 培养基扰动两类生物工具；(c) 一条「基因–文本对齐 → 智能体 SFT → 反事实 GRPO」的训练流水线，其中反事实基因接地奖励通过真实基因组嵌入与零基因消融的逐 token 对数概率差，强制策略在因果意义上依赖基因组输入而不仅是模仿格式。实验表明，性能提升的主引擎是智能体式工具使用训练而非单纯的基因组注入，RL 的反事实奖励与工具整形进一步带来系统性但幅度较小的改进；4B 模型在多数任务上可与参数量大一个数量级的通用 LLM 竞争，说明显式的基因组接地能替代相当一部分通用模型容量。局限包括：每菌株仅用单一压缩基因表示（1×2560 CLS 向量）注入，丢失基因/通路级与结构信息，对底物利用、代谢能力与胁迫响应等依赖局部基因组证据的任务尤其不利，作者建议未来引入多基因 token、基因集感知池化与基因特征自适应检索；此外消融仅给出方向性结论，未系统报告统计显著性，部分 SFT 子任务样本极少（电子供体 46、电子受体 78），且边界类指标绝对值仍低（如温度区间 ICR 仅 0.182），距离实用级培养条件推荐尚有差距。应用上，作者强调模型输出应视为待验证假设而非实验指令，须经专家复核并遵循生物安全规范。

title: PolitNuggets: Benchmarking Agentic Discovery of Long-Tail Political Facts
comment: 24 pages, 7 figues, accpeted in The 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL 2026)
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) embedded in agentic frameworks have transformed information retrieval from static, long context question answering into open-ended exploration. Yet real world use requires models to discover and synthesize "long-tail" facts from dispersed sources, a capability that remains under-evaluated. We introduce PolitNuggets, a multilingual benchmark for agentic information synthesis via constructing political biographies for 400 global elites, covering over 10000 political facts. We standardize evaluation with an optimized multi agent system and propose FactNet, an evidence conditional protocol that scores discovery, fine-grained accuracy, and efficiency. Across models and settings, we find that current systems often struggle with fine-grained details, and vary substantially in efficiency. Finally, using benchmark diagnostics, we relate agent performance to underlying model capabilities, highlighting the importance of short-context extraction, multilingual robustness, and reliable tool use.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PolitNuggets：一个多语言基准，要求智能体（LRM + 工具）在开放网页中为 400 位全球政治人物构建含 10,000+ 条"长尾"政治事实的完整履历（角色/机构/年月/精确职务头衔等槽位）。配套提出 FactNet 证据条件式评测协议（动态新颖性真值 + 事件级/属性级 F1 + 效率成本），发现现有系统精度高但召回低、非美国实体显著退化，并提出"长上下文悖论"：长上下文阅读能力无法可靠预测智能体端到端表现，真正决定成败的是短上下文抽取精度、多语言鲁棒性与可靠工具使用。
AI.motivation: 大推理模型（LRM）嵌入智能体框架后，信息检索从"上下文内推理"（Reasoning in Context，被动给定证据）转向"穿越上下文的推理"（Reasoning through Context，主动探索、筛选、自建上下文），但缺乏面向长时程、跨语言、碎片化证据综合的严格基准。现有智能体评测多聚焦短程交互或孤立事实检索，无法衡量从分散甚至相互矛盾的来源中重建连贯叙事这一真实专业工作流；同时几乎无人将"上下文内推理"能力与"穿越上下文推理"能力建立联系。Wikipedia 对非美国官员存在系统性覆盖缺口，且在学术研究、政治咨询等专业领域缺乏细粒度精度，因此"构建政治人物传记"是兼具影响力与真实性的任务载体。
AI.method: 1）基准构建：从 WhoGov（5.8万+ 全球内阁成员，1966–2023）随机采样 200 名非美国内阁政治人物 + 200 名美国议员/参议员，经预处理过滤得 400 实体评估集，覆盖 10,000+ 政治事实；并统计各国检索证据的英语/非英语 token 分布以刻画多语言负担。2）任务形式化：目标传记隐含为有向图 G=(V,E)，节点为原子"nugget"，边为时序/因果链接；智能体在预算约束下最大化对缺失事件 G\W 的召回，形成正确性-覆盖-成本三难。3）评测协议 FactNet：增量式构建"整合真值 CGT"（汇总多轮智能体运行证据、经 gpt-5-mini 裁判验证），Wikipedia 仅作覆盖过滤 W；候选预测若不在 CGT 中则触发"新颖性验证"（用系统自身 Archive 证据校验），生成动态真值 G′，据此计算 Event-Level F1（角色/机构/年份正确）与 Attribute-Level F1（额外要求起止月份±1月与精确头衔），并以平均搜索步数与总 token 计效率。4）系统实现：Supervisor–Searcher 多智能体架构（Supervisor 维护全局摘要与 to-do 列表并决定终止；Searcher 执行检索/浏览并写入 Archive 持久化证据），外加 Coder 智能体将证据映射为严格 JSON；限制每个 to-do 至多 3 次检索、全局 100 次 LLM 调用上限。5）实验条件：With Wiki（增强验证）与 Without Wiki（冷启动重建）；评测 Grok-4-Fast、Gemini-2.5-Flash、Qwen-3 225B/80B，并以 Gemini DeepResearch 作对比；另构造 8 类"上下文内推理"基线（Archive 短上下文 ~30k token vs 拼接原始网页长上下文 ~300k token，同一批证据语料）；另做 Archive 消融与 6 维能力诊断（短上下文抽取、长上下文召回、长短差距、闭卷参数知识、多语言鲁棒性、BFCL 工具可靠性）+ bootstrap 显著性检验与人工/Exa 独立核查。
AI.result: 1）发现1（召回而非精度是瓶颈）：Grok-4-Fast With Wiki 事件级 F1 达 US 0.768 / Non-US 0.712，属性级降至 0.501 / 0.475；精度持续偏高（如 0.89–0.91）而召回偏低（0.28–0.70），智能体倾向保守、漏掉弱连接的长尾事件而非编造。Gemini DeepResearch 精度更高（0.912/0.892）但召回更低，属更保守的操作点。2）发现2（国际证据鸿沟）：多数模型 Non-US 显著退化，Qwen-225B 事件级 0.499→0.440、Qwen-80B 0.510→0.412（相对降幅最高约 40%），Grok 事件级差 −0.056/−0.058（bootstrap CI 不含 0，显著）；根源是英文来源稀缺与非美国政府档案解析复杂，导致非英语证据推理保真度不足。3）发现3（效率鸿沟）：移除 Wiki 使成本大幅上升而准确率仅小幅变化（Grok 步数 11.17→14.52、token +6.7 万；Gemini 步数 13.53→18.04、token +29.2 万，均显著）；Grok 以更少步数达同等 F1，位于效率 Pareto 前沿（左上"nice zone"），Gemini 以"暴力搜索"换取准确率。4）记忆消融：移除 Archive 使事件级 F1 下降约 0.05（β≈−0.05，显著），证实原始证据持久化对纵向综合不可或缺。5）LRM 基线：所有静态上下文基线均弱于最佳智能体设置；长上下文一致劣于短上下文（Grok US 0.626→0.538，约 −14.1%）；纯记忆（闭卷）基线极低（EventF1 0.15–0.25），说明记忆泄漏存在但非决定性因素。6）能力诊断与"长上下文悖论"：短上下文抽取能力与端到端 F1 强正相关（"最后一公里"瓶颈），而长上下文召回、长–短差距与端到端表现关系弱/不稳定；闭卷参数知识与 BFCL 工具可靠性呈正相关，前者充当语义脚手架（消歧、查询改写、识别有价值的 nugget），后者降低工具执行脆弱性。7）方法学验证：人工重判 40 名官员与 LLM 裁判一致性相关系数 0.87；Exa 对 100 名官员 2,243 条 nugget 复核发现 82 个假阳性（≈3.66% 不准确率）；GPT-5-Mini 因反复搜索循环、无法在 T=100 内终止而被剔除。
AI.conclusion: PolitNuggets 将智能体信息综合评测从"给定上下文内的推理"推进到"穿越上下文的推理"，提供 400 位全球政治人物传记构建基准与可扩展的 FactNet 证据条件式协议。总体结论：当前系统在精度上表现良好，但性能受召回（长尾覆盖）与效率双重制约；移除 Wikipedia 上下文会显著抬高搜索成本；非美国实体存在突出的国际证据鸿沟，须在下游使用中明确披露；消融证明证据持久化（Archive）是核心设计。据此，真实智能体的瓶颈不在"更多思考"而在更高效的检索与查询规划、短上下文抽取精度、多语言推理保真度与可靠工具调用，而非单纯扩大上下文窗口——即"长上下文悖论"。局限包括未评测最昂贵的顶级前沿模型、搜索引擎与网页漂移导致结果随时间波动、静态 LRM 基线语料来自智能体采集因而不足以断言"穿越上下文"优于"上下文内"推理。

title: Towards the Next Frontier of LLMs, Training on Private Data: A Cross-Domain Benchmark for Federated Fine-Tuning
summary:
The recent success of large language models (LLMs) has been largely driven by vast public datasets. However, the next frontier for LLM development lies beyond public data. Much of the world's most valuable information is private, especially in highly regulated sectors such as healthcare and finance, where data include patient histories or customer communications. Unlocking this data could represent a major leap forward, enabling LLMs with deeper domain expertise and stronger real-world utility. Yet, these data cannot be shared because they are distributed across institutions and constrained by privacy, regulatory, and organizational barriers. Moreover, institutional datasets are typically non-independent and identically distributed (non-IID), differing across sites in population characteristics, data modalities, documentation patterns, and task-specific label distributions.
  In this paper, we demonstrate a practical approach to unlocking private and distributed institutional data for LLM adaptation through federated collaboration across data silos. Built on the Sherpa.ai Federated Learning platform, our framework enables nodes to jointly fine-tune a shared LLM without exchanging private data. We evaluate this approach through a cross-domain benchmark in healthcare and finance, using four closed-ended question answering and classification datasets: MedQA, MedMCQA, FPB, and FiQA-SA. We compare three parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) strategies-LoRA, QLoRA, and IA3-across pretrained backbones under non-IID settings reflecting institutional data heterogeneity. Our results show that federated fine-tuning performs close to centralized training and outperforms isolated single-institution learning. From a Green AI perspective, QLoRA and IA3 improve efficiency with limited accuracy degradation, supporting federated PEFT as a viable approach for adapting LLMs where data cannot be shared.

AI.tldr: 本文基于 Sherpa.ai 联邦学习平台提出一个受控的跨领域基准测试，在医疗（MedQA、MedMCQA）与金融（FPB、FiQA-SA）四个封闭式问答/分类数据集上，用 Dirichlet 划分模拟 5 个机构的 non-IID 分布，对比 LoRA、QLoRA、IA3 三种 PEFT 方法在集中式、联邦式与单机构式三种训练场景下的表现，并同时报告通信开销与显存占用。结论：联邦微调性能接近集中式、显著优于孤立单机构训练；LoRA 精度最佳，QLoRA 显存最省，IA3 通信最省。
AI.motivation: 当前 LLM 的突破高度依赖公开数据，而医疗、金融等高监管领域最有价值的知识（病历、客户沟通、交易与合规文本）分散在各机构内部，受隐私、法规与组织边界限制无法集中；同时机构数据天然呈现 non-IID（人群、模态、标注模式、标签分布差异）。虽然已有工作（FedLLM-Bench、FlowerTune 等）推进了联邦 LLM 微调基准，但普遍存在只覆盖单领域/单基准/单适配策略、缺少同一实验协议下跨训练范式与效率维度的受控对比的问题。此外，真实部署中通信开销、显存占用、对异质数据的鲁棒性与准确率同等重要。因此需要一个面向敏感领域、同时衡量"相对完全集中化的性能损失"与"相对孤立单机构训练的增益"的聚焦式受控基准（作者明确声明不提出新 FL 算法或优化方法）。
AI.method: 在 Sherpa.ai 联邦学习平台上实现横向联邦（Horizontal FL）PEFT 微调框架：冻结预训练主干参数 θ，仅训练任务特定参数 φ；节点本地微调 → 上传 φ_k 或 Δφ_k → 服务器按 FedAvg 加权平均（权重 N_k/ΣN_ℓ）→ 广播全局 φ，原始样本与标签不出域。节点划分采用 Dirichlet 标签分布非 IID 协议，5 个节点，FPB 取 α=0.7、FiQA-SA/MedQA/MedMCQA 取 α=1.0，并以 Hellinger 距离 ≥0.5 作为明显异质性的参考阈值。数据集：FiQA-SA（金融情感，连续分值按 −0.05/0.05 阈值映射为 A/B/C 三类）、FPB（4,840 条金融语句情感三分类，官方划分）、MedQA（USMLE 风格多选）、MedMCQA（>194k 题、21 个医学主题，过滤为有效单选题，因无公开标注测试集而在官方验证集上评测）。预处理统一为 prompt-completion 对，仅在 completion token 上计算损失，prompt 与 padding 掩码，最大长度 512 token。PEFT：LoRA/QLoRA（r=32、α=21、dropout=0.1，目标模块运行时自动推断）与 IA3（作用于 k_proj、v_proj、down_proj）。骨干模型 9 个（II-Medical-8B-1706、Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507、Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct、FineMedLM-o1、gemma-2-9b-it、gemma-3-4b-it）。统一协议：paged_adamw_8bit、lr=1e-4、bs=4、bf16、梯度检查点、max_norm=1.0、恒定 lr 调度 + 10 步 warmup、种子 42；联邦为 4 轮通信 × 每轮 1 个本地 epoch（全节点参与），集中式与单机构基线同样训练 4 epoch 以保证公平。指标：准确率；每轮通信量 2KB_train/1024^3；显存为各节点 PyTorch 峰值保留显存均值。
AI.result: 医疗域：II-Medical-8B-1706 全面最优，LoRA 集中式 MedQA 0.740、MedMCQA 0.763，联邦为 0.714 与 0.742；Qwen3-8B 联邦 MedQA 0.683 / MedMCQA 0.718；多数配置下联邦 ≈ 集中式且明显优于单机构（如 MedQA 0.659→0.740→0.714）。LoRA 总体最强，QLoRA 次之，IA3 偏弱且在 MedMCQA 上差距更明显；弱/小模型差距更明显。金融域更异质：FPB 集中式最佳为 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct+LoRA 0.873，联邦最佳为 Qwen3-8B 0.863；FiQA-SA 集中式最佳为 Qwen3-8B+LoRA 0.915，联邦最佳为 gemma-2-9b-it+LoRA 0.923（联邦超过集中式），无单一模型全面占优。效率上：LoRA 与 QLoRA 每轮通信量相同（如 Qwen3-8B 1.510 GB、Qwen3-4B 0.944 GB、gemma-2-9b-it 1.541 GB），IA3 通信量低两个数量级（0.005–0.025 GB）；显存上 QLoRA 系统性最优（Qwen3-8B 由 LoRA 的 ~28.7 GB 降至 ~20.7 GB；II-Medical-8B 由 35.9 GB 降至 24.2 GB），IA3 与 LoRA 显存接近，因冻结主干占据主导。
AI.conclusion: 联邦 PEFT 可作为在原始数据无法集中时的可行、可扩展的 LLM 适配方案：在受控 non-IID 条件下，其性能通常接近集中式且明显优于孤立单机构学习，说明统计异质性会损害但不会致命地影响 LLM 微调，前提是骨干模型与 PEFT 策略足够稳健。模型与适配器选型取决于部署约束：医疗域偏好领域专用模型（II-Medical-8B-1706），金融域更偏任务依赖（Qwen3-8B、Qwen2.5-1.5B、gemma-2-9b-it 各擅胜场）；追求精度选 LoRA，显存受限选 QLoRA，通信受限选 IA3（但常牺牲精度）。作者同时明确澄清：FL 仅保障数据本地性，本身不提供抗梯度反演/重构攻击的形式化隐私保证，差分隐私、安全聚合、TEE、密码学协议均不在本文范围；与 GPT-4、Med-PaLM 2 等结果因协议/划分/训练设定不同只能作参照而非直接基线。从 Green AI 视角，"更绿色的适配"不仅取决于选小模型，也取决于选择与部署约束匹配的微调策略，未来基准应常规化报告效率指标。

title: Falkor-IRAC: Graph-Constrained Generation for Verified Legal Reasoning in Indian Judicial AI
summary: Legal reasoning is not semantic similarity search. A court judgment encodes constrained symbolic reasoning: precedent propagation, procedural state transitions, and statute-bound inference. These are properties that vector-based retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) cannot faithfully represent. Hallucinated precedents, outdated statute citations, and unsupported reasoning chains remain persistent failure modes in LLM-based legal AI, with real consequences for access to justice in high-caseload jurisdictions such as India. This paper presents Falkor-IRAC, a graph-constrained generation framework for Indian legal AI that grounds generation in structured reasoning over an IRAC (Issue, Rule, Analysis, Conclusion) knowledge graph. Judgments from the Supreme Court and High Courts of India are ingested as IRAC node structures enriched with procedural state transitions, precedent relationships, and statutory references, stored in FalkorDB for low-latency agentic traversal. At inference time, LLM-generated answers are accepted only if a valid supporting path can be traced through the graph, a check performed by a falsifiability oracle called the Verifier Agent. The system also detects doctrinal conflicts as a first-class output rather than silently resolving them. Falkor-IRAC is evaluated using graph-native metrics: citation grounding accuracy, path validity rate, hallucinated precedent rate, and conflict detection rate. These metrics are argued to be more appropriate for legal reasoning evaluation than BLEU and ROUGE. On a proof-of-concept corpus of 51 Supreme Court judgments, the Verifier Agent correctly validated citations on completed queries and correctly rejected fabricated citations. Evaluation against vector-only RAG baselines is left for future work, as is GPU-accelerated inference to address current timeout rates on CPU hardware.

AI.tldr: Falkor-IRAC 是一个面向印度法律 AI 的图约束生成框架：把最高法院与高等法院判决解析为 IRAC（争点—规则—论证—结论）知识图谱，并加入程序状态转移、先例关系与法条引用，存入 FalkorDB 供低延迟智能体遍历；在推理阶段，只有当能沿图追踪出有效支撑路径时，LLM 生成的答案才被接受，该校验由名为 Verifier Agent 的可证伪性预言机（falsifiability oracle）执行；系统还能把教义冲突作为一等输出显式暴露，而非静默消解。评估使用图原生指标（引用接地准确率、路径有效率、幻觉先例率、冲突检出率），主张比 BLEU/ROUGE 更适合法律推理评测。在 51 篇最高法院判决的概念验证语料上，Verifier Agent 对已完成查询正确验证了引用，并正确拒绝了捏造引用；与纯向量 RAG 基线的对比、GPU 加速推理留待未来工作。
AI.motivation: 论文的核心论点是：法律推理不是语义相似度检索，法院判决承载的是受约束的符号推理——先例传播（precedent propagation）、程序状态转移（procedural state transitions）与法条约束的推论（statute-bound inference），这些是向量式 RAG 无法忠实表达的结构属性。由此产生的三类顽疾失败模式为：幻觉先例、过时法条引用、无支撑的推理链；在印度这类高案件量辖区，这类错误对司法可及性有现实影响。作者进一步指出，现有以 BLEU/ROUGE 为代表的字面重叠类指标无法刻画"论证链是否可追溯"，因此需要图原生的评测维度。
AI.method: 1) 语料摄取：将印度最高法院与高等法院判决抽取为 IRAC（Issue、Rule、Analysis、Conclusion）节点结构，并富化程序状态转移、先例关系（citing/cited-by）与法条引用边。2) 存储层：使用 FalkorDB（基于 Redis 的图数据库）存储知识图谱，支持低延迟的 agentic traversal——智能体沿图路径而非嵌入相似度导航。3) 生成与验证：在推理时先由 LLM 生成答案，再由 Verifier Agent 作为可证伪性预言机检查是否存在从 IRAC 节点出发、经先例与法条关系到达结论节点的有效支撑路径；无有效路径即拒答或标记。4) 冲突处理：将教义冲突（doctrinal conflict）建模为图上的一等输出对象，显式呈现而非自动消解。5) 评测：以图原生指标替代 BLEU/ROUGE，包括 citation grounding accuracy、path validity rate、hallucinated precedent rate、conflict detection rate。
AI.result: 在 51 篇最高法院判决构成的概念验证语料上，Verifier Agent 在已完成的查询中正确验证了引用（citation grounding），并成功拒绝了伪造引用（falsifiability 检查有效）。该结果证明了"图上可追溯支撑路径"作为幻觉拦截闸门的可行性。由于语料规模小（51 篇）、任务局限于引文验证，论文明确将以下工作留待未来：与纯向量 RAG 基线的对照实验（以量化图约束相对语义检索的增益），以及 GPU 加速推理以解决当前 CPU 硬件上的超时率问题。同时，摘要未给出各图原生指标的具体数值表格，评测的统计强度仍有限。
AI.conclusion: 论文主张：法律 AI 应从"检索相似文本"转向"在受约束的符号图上做可验证推理"。Falkor-IRAC 的贡献不在于提高生成流畅度，而在于把可审计性内建于系统架构——答案的合法性由图上支撑路径的存在与否判定，教义冲突被显式化，评测指标也从字面重叠转向结构正确性。其定位是概念验证（proof-of-concept）：51 篇判决、单指标维度（引文验证）、缺乏向量 RAG 基线对照，说明结论目前仅支持"该机制可行"而非"该机制更优"。作者同时坦承工程瓶颈（CPU 上的推理超时），暗示该框架的可部署性目前受限于推理成本与图遍历延迟。

title: Dual Hierarchical Dialogue Policy Learning for Legal Inquisitive Conversational Agents
summary: Most existing dialogue systems are user-driven, primarily designed to fulfill user requests. However, in many critical real-world scenarios, a conversational agent must proactively extract information to achieve its own objectives rather than merely respond. To address this gap, we introduce \emph{Inquisitive Conversational Agents (ICAs)} and develop an ICA specifically tailored to U.S. Supreme Court oral arguments. We propose a Dual Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning framework featuring two cooperating RL agents, each with its own policy, to coordinate strategic dialogue management and fine-grained utterance generation. By learning when and how to ask probing questions, the agent emulates judicial questioning patterns and systematically uncovers crucial information to fulfill its legal objectives. Evaluations on a U.S. Supreme Court dataset show that our method outperforms various baselines across multiple metrics. It represents an important first step toward broader high-stakes, domain-specific applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出质询式对话系统（ICAs）概念，针对美国最高法院口头辩论场景构建专门系统。通过双层次强化学习框架实现战略对话管理与话语生成的协调，使智能体能够学习何时提问以及如何提问，模拟法官的质询模式以获取关键法律信息。
AI.motivation: 现有对话系统多为用户驱动型，仅被动响应用户请求。在法律辩护等高风险实际场景中，智能体需要主动挖掘信息以实现自身目标，而非被动回应，因此提出Inquisitive Conversational Agents (ICAs)。
AI.method: 提出Dual Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning框架，采用两个协同的RL智能体，每个智能体拥有独立策略，协调战略层面的对话管理与战术层面的细粒度话语生成。
AI.result: 在美国最高法院数据集上的评估表明，该方法在多个指标上优于多个基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 该研究首次将质询式对话系统应用于法律领域，为高风险、领域特定应用提供了重要参考。通过双层次RL框架实现了战略对话管理与细粒度话语生成的协调，为类似场景下的主动式对话系统设计提供了新思路。

title: GAMBIT: A Three-Mode Benchmark for Adversarial Robustness in Multi-Agent LLM Collectives
summary: In multi-agent systems (MAS), a single deceptive agent can nullify all gains of an agentic AI collective and evade deployed defenses. However, existing adversarial studies on MAS target only shallow tasks and do not consider adaptive adversaries, which evolve their strategies to evade the very detectors trained to catch them. To address that gap, we introduce GAMBIT, a benchmark with three evaluation modes and two independent scores for evaluating imposter detectors: the first two modes measure zero-shot detection under increasing distribution shift, and a third recalibration mode measures how quickly a detector adapts to novel attacks from just 20 labeled examples. The benchmark comes with a dataset of 27,804 labeled instances spanning 240 co-evolved imposter strategies. Our contributions are threefold: (1) Using chess as a substrate deep reasoning problem and Gemini 3.1 Pro for agents, we release GAMBIT and its dataset to evaluate imposter detectors under realistic constraints against a stealthy adaptive imposter; (2) We introduce an adaptive imposter agent based on an efficient evolutionary framework, generalizable beyond chess, that collapses collective task performance while remaining essentially undetectable (50.5% F1-score with a Gemini-based detector); (3) We show that zero-shot evaluation can be highly misleading for adaptive adversaries: two detectors with near-identical zero-shot scores differ by 8x on few-shot adaptation, while the meta-learned variant converges 20x faster, a gap only visible in the recalibration mode. Altogether, GAMBIT provides the first multi-agent benchmark where adversarial attacks and defenses co-evolve, with an imposter framework generalizable beyond our use case, and promising techniques for fast recalibration in a rapidly evolving adversarial system. Code and data: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/gambit.

AI.tldr: GAMBIT is a new benchmark for evaluating imposter/deception detectors in multi-agent systems against adaptive adversaries. It uses chess as a reasoning substrate, includes 27,804 labeled instances with 240 co-evolved imposter strategies, and demonstrates that zero-shot evaluation is insufficient for adaptive threats; recalibration capability is critical, with meta-learning achieving 20x faster convergence.
AI.motivation: In multi-agent systems, a single deceptive agent can nullify all gains of an agentic AI collective and evade deployed defenses. Existing adversarial studies target only shallow tasks and do not consider adaptive adversaries that evolve strategies to evade detectors.
AI.method: Uses chess as a deep reasoning substrate with Gemini 3.1 Pro agents. Introduces an adaptive imposter agent based on an efficient evolutionary framework that collapses collective task performance while remaining essentially undetectable. Benchmark includes three evaluation modes (two zero-shot modes with increasing distribution shift, and a recalibration mode) with 27,804 labeled instances spanning 240 co-evolved imposter strategies.
AI.result: The imposter achieves 50.5% F1-score with a Gemini-based detector while collapsing collective task performance. Zero-shot evaluation can be highly misleading: detectors with near-identical zero-shot scores differ by 8x on few-shot adaptation, while meta-learned variants converge 20x faster—gaps only visible in the recalibration mode.
AI.conclusion: GAMBIT provides the first multi-agent benchmark where adversarial attacks and defenses co-evolve, with a generalizable imposter framework and promising fast recalibration techniques for evolving adversarial systems.

title: Conditional Attribute Estimation with Autoregressive Sequence Models
summary: Generative models are often trained with a next-token prediction objective, yet many downstream applications require the ability to estimate or control sequence-level properties. Next-token prediction can lead to overfitting of local patterns during training, underfitting of global structure, and requires significant downstream modifications or expensive sampling to guide or predict the global attributes of generated samples at inference time. Here, we introduce Conditional Attribute Transformers, a novel method for jointly estimating the next-token probability and the value of an attribute conditional on each potential next token selection. This framework enables three critical capabilities within a single forward pass, without modification of the input sequence: (1) per-token credit assignment across an entire sequence, by identifying how each token in a sequence is associated with an attribute's value; (2) counterfactual analysis, by quantifying attribute differences conditional on alternative next token choices; (3) steerable generation, by decoding sequences based on a combination of next-token and attribute likelihoods.
